name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Know what you really make. Tip Tracker is a private tip tracker and shift log for people who work for tips. Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash, card — and see your real hourly rate the moment you save it.

WHAT IT DOES
Most apps stop at "how much did you make tonight". This tip tracker answers the harder question: what did that shift actually pay you per hour, after you tipped out? Enter your hours and your server tips, add your tip-out and your base wage, and it does the arithmetic you would otherwise be doing in your head at 1am.

• Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash tips, card tips, tip-out
• Your effective hourly rate: base wage + tips − tip-out, over hours worked
• Track income by shift, by week and by month
• Watch your hourly rate trend across shifts as one smoothed line
• Find your best nights — which shifts actually pay, by day of the week
• A full income history you can browse as a list or on a calendar
• More than one job, each with its own wage and its own numbers
• Export your shift log as a CSV whenever you want it
• Optional tip percentage, if you log your sales

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add where you work, and your base wage if you get one.
2. At the end of the night, open the app and enter your hours and your tips.
3. Save. You immediately see what you kept and what it worked out to per hour.
4. Come back next shift. Two shifts in, you can compare them.

THE AFTER-MIDNIGHT RULE
A shift that ends at 1:40am belongs to the night that started yesterday. Between midnight and 6am this tip log files a new entry under the previous day automatically — so your week totals, your income tracker and your day-of-week stats stay right without you thinking about it. The date is always editable.

WHY THE HOURLY RATE
Two hundred dollars is a great night on a five-hour Friday and an ordinary one on a twelve-hour double. Totals alone can't tell you which shifts to ask for, which sections pay, or whether the new schedule is actually better. An hourly rate can. That is why this server tip tracker leads with the rate on every screen and draws the trend of it over time.

YOUR HISTORY, KEPT PROPERLY
Every shift you log stays. Browse your server tips as a running list or as a month calendar where the busier nights sit darker, so a season's shape is visible at a glance. Weekly and monthly summaries add up hours, tips and what you kept, and each one carries its own rate so you can compare a slow February against a good July honestly. Nothing expires and nothing is trimmed.

WHO IT IS FOR
Servers and waitresses. Bartenders and barbacks. Baristas, hosts and bussers. Delivery drivers and couriers. Hair stylists, barbers and nail techs. Valets, bellhops, casino dealers, catering and banquet staff. Anyone whose income arrives as tips and whose paycheck never tells the whole story.

A REAL INCOME LOG, FASTER THAN A SPREADSHEET
Built for a phone in a server station, not a desk. Every number in this income tracker is one you typed: nothing is estimated, nothing is averaged against other people, and nothing is filled in for you. The tip log adds it up and shows you the result — that's the whole product.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your data stays on your device — no account, no cloud. There is no sign-in and no server, so your shift log works with no signal at all: a basement bar, a walk-in, a parking garage. Your shifts are never uploaded anywhere. No ads, ever.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Your shifts, your jobs, your rates and your whole history live in one app that opens instantly and works anywhere. Pick up a second job and its numbers stay separate from the first. Export a CSV of your own records whenever you want one — it is your data and it stays yours. This shift log is quick enough to fill in while you are cashing out, and detailed enough that it still makes sense a year later when you are looking back at a whole season of server tips.

For your personal records only — not tax, accounting, or financial advice.

name: Tip+: Restaurant Tip Manager
description:
Tip+ is the most customizable tip calculator built for how real restaurants actually work.

Every restaurant splits tips differently. Some pool everything and divide by hours. Some tip out the bar 10%, the food runners 5%, and the busser a flat amount. Some pay servers on sales, not tips. Most tip calculators pick one of these and force you to live with it. Tip+ lets you set your own rules — and change them shift by shift when reality doesn't cooperate.

DOWN TO EARTH, NOT OVERBUILT

Tip+ is made for the person who closes the restaurant at midnight, not for an accounting department. No jargon. No forced workflows. No "enterprise" features you'll never touch. Open the app, enter what happened tonight, split the tips, go home.

CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING

• Splits your way — by hours, by role weight, by fixed percentage, by flat amount, or any combination.
• Role weights — servers 1.0, bar 0.8, runners 0.5 — whatever your house rule is.
• Tip-outs — pull a percentage off the top for the kitchen, bar, or support before the pool is split.
• Overrides — bump someone up for a great night, adjust for a mid-shift role change, or exclude a no-show, all with a note attached.
• Templates — save the shift structures you run every week so setup takes seconds.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Dashboard — today's tips, active shifts, and recent settlements at a glance.

Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique, thanks to our built-in Pomodoro mode.

The idea behind the Pomodoro technique is that you can work more effectively when you work in timed, 25-minute increments (with breaks in between). Favorites allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used time entries. Start tracking time on a favorite time entry with one tap.

◼ Notifications
Enable notifications so that you always know if & what are you tracking (or if you're not tracking anything!), and always be aware where does your time go.

Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients and tags. Clearly see where your work hours go and adjust your precious time & routines accordingly.

By using @ and #, you can quickly add those projects and tags much faster and get back to work right away!

◼ Widgets
Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

◼ Sync
Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

◼ Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

◽ But what if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

◽ Can I send you some feedback?
You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. Whether you are at an office, in commute, stuck on a space mission to Mars or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money - track your time anywhere you go!

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

This is a partial list of the DriverLog functionalities :
• Automatically calculates and displays current and available driving and on duty time in drivers’ shift and cycle.
• Allows review of six months of day-by-day history.
• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)
• Alerts the driver of upcoming shift and/or cycle time violations
• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

Gamepad Support: Plug in for an immersive experience.
Pinch to zoom and scout truck stop docks like a pro.

Signature Guidelines
Our colored lines make reversing a breeze:

Red Line: Shows where your trailer’s headed—key for tight parking.
Green Lines: Check truck-trailer alignment, like mirror glances.
Blue Line: Guides your truck’s path when steering straight.
Inspired by real-world CDL training, these lines make top-down parking intuitive across the USA, Canada, and Mexico.

Why You’ll Love It
Realistic Physics: Built with Godot, trailers handle like real Class A rigs, from 1 to 4 axles.
Tons of Levels: Beginner to “Crazy” challenges for CDL hopefuls and pros.
Life System: Hit a curb? Lose a life, keep parking with up to 5 lives.
Fast-Forward Mode: Speed through long reversing moves.
Haptic Feedback: Feel the road (on supported devices).
No Ads Option: Unlock ad-free play or full campaigns for uninterrupted trucking.
Built by a Trucker, for Truckers
With 150+ students trained, our creator knows the grind of backing up a rig. This isn’t just a game—it’s your ticket to acing your CDL test and ruling truck stops. Whether you’re a rookie or a gear-jamming veteran in the USA, Canada, or Mexico, My US Trucking Skills is the top Class A truck parking simulator.

Download now and reverse that semi like a boss!

description:
Shift Core is the professional offline shift tracker for field technicians and inspectors who require secure, audit-ready records. Manage your entire workday on your device with our dedicated offline shift tracker requiring no internet connection, no accounts, and no cloud sync. A True Offline Shift Tracker
• Work anywhere without an internet connection, from basements and tunnels to remote sites where signal is unavailable.

Detailed Task & Shift Logging

notes for context.

• Save time on repetitive jobs by duplicating existing tasks, carrying over details like location and item type.
• Find any past entry in seconds using full-text search across your entire history, with powerful date-range
filtering.

Audit-Ready PDF & CSV Reports
• Generate professional, multi-page PDF reports branded with your company logo and custom accent color for a polished look.
• Capture touch-drawn digital signatures for on-site client or supervisor sign-off, attached per task or per report.
• Embed a space-efficient grid of photos directly into your PDF reports, providing clear visual proof of work performed.
• Export detailed CSV files formatted for easy import into billing or invoicing software, including hours worked and work order data.

How Your Offline Shift Tracker Works
Shift Core makes complex field logging simple. A site inspector arrives on location, opens the app, and taps 'Start Shift' to begin tracking time. For the first task, like a fire extinguisher check, they create a new entry, scan the unit's barcode to populate the work order number, and mark its status as 'Pass'. They snap two photos of the gauge and tag, which are automatically attached to the task record.

Throughout the day, they repeat this process, duplicating similar tasks to work faster. If a unit fails inspection, they mark it 'Fail', add detailed notes, and photograph the issue for the follow-up team. Before leaving, the building manager provides a digital signature directly on the device screen. Upon tapping 'End Shift', a complete, branded PDF report is generated, which the inspector shares directly to the client's email.

Analytics & Job History
• Review your performance with an integrated analytics dashboard showing pass/fail rates and task trends over time.
• Archive completed shifts instead of permanently deleting them, preserving a complete, searchable job history indefinitely.
• Instantly undo accidental archiving with a single tap to restore shifts from the archive back to your active list.

Designed for fire safety inspectors, maintenance crews, site supervisors, HVAC and electrical contractors, and any professional performing site visits that demand a reliable work log.

If you need a robust offline shift tracker, this is built for you.

name: Jolly Classroom
description:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons with ease. With over 150 structured lessons, engaging activities and built-in phonics assessments, this app ensures that students develop strong reading and writing skills in a fun and research-backed way.

A Complete Classroom Solution
Jolly Classroom provides a structured, step-by-step approach to teaching phonics, grammar and spelling. Aligned with the Science of Reading, the app focuses on building essential phonemic awareness, reading fluency and writing accuracy in a way that is engaging and easy to follow.

What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation – Course introducing complex concepts of English Grammar in a fun and easy way
3. Built-in Phonics Assessments – Includes Jolly Phonics assessments and phonics screening tests to track student progress
4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence.

Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

description:
📚 A more flexible teaching workflow—alongside your SIS

Your school or district SIS is the official system of record. Teacher Gradebook gives you a flexible daily workspace for the teaching work behind those records: grading, assessment, attendance, lesson planning, notes, student progress, and reports.

Use it alongside the SIS your school requires. Calculate and analyze grades your way, collect assessment evidence, and prepare the information you later enter into the official system. Teacher Gradebook works independently: it does not replace or automatically sync with your SIS.

Tired of juggling spreadsheets, paper notes, calendars, and multiple SIS screens? Bring your daily classroom workflow together in one organized app.

👨‍🏫 Built by a teacher, for teachers

Teacher Gradebook was created by a classroom teacher who understands the realities of teaching. It is intuitive, visual, and flexible, so you can adapt it to your grading system without being a technology expert.

📊 Grade and assess your way

• Enter numeric grades, text, icons, and visual ratings
• Calculate simple or weighted averages
• Create custom formulas and calculated columns
• Configure weights, rounding, and reassessments
• Use rubrics, checklists, and rating scales
• Create editable rubrics with AI assistance
• Assess students individually or in teams
• Add comments and observations
• Export grades and reports to PDF or CSV

Teacher Gradebook adapts to your assessment approach instead of forcing your classroom into a rigid template. Every result remains clear, editable, and traceable.

📅 Organize your classroom

• Track attendance, absences, tardies, and incidents
• Create seating charts and take attendance directly from the chart
• Manage class schedules and non-instructional days
• Plan lessons, class sessions, and instructional units
• Add reminders and view upcoming sessions
• Keep a class journal by date, class, or student
• Store student profiles, contacts, photos, notes, and files

Your grades, attendance, planner, journal, and student profiles share the same information, so you do not have to enter the same data repeatedly.

📈 See progress clearly

Review grades, attendance, ungraded activities, and classroom notes without rebuilding everything at the end of a grading period.

• Individual student and whole-class reports
• Grade charts and statistics
• Attendance and class journal reports
• Edit compatible grades and comments directly from the Grade Report
• Create editable AI-assisted narrative reports before exporting

🔒 Private, offline, and under your control

Your academic data is stored encrypted on your device. You can do your core classroom work without an Internet connection and protect access to the app with a password.

Student information is not stored on the developer’s servers. Optional cloud backups go directly to your own Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive account. You can also configure automatic backups and choose where your information is stored.

🎨 Make it yours

Customize colors, icons, columns, layouts, and table styles. Use light or dark mode and work comfortably on both phones and tablets.

Keep your required SIS as the official record. Use Teacher Gradebook as your personal, flexible workspace for the daily work that official grades are built on.

Spend less time managing spreadsheets and administrative tasks—and more time teaching and supporting your students.

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

name: ZipGrade
description:
Grade multiple choice tests, quizzes, and assessments instantly in the classroom by using your Android device's camera as a grading scanner. ZipGrade is a grading app that makes grading effortless while capturing, storing, and reporting with useful data on assessments. No need to wait for the Scantron machine or sheetfed scanner to grade papers quickly.

Students receive immediate feedback and can see their score on a test as soon as they're done. Teachers can have all of their multiple-choice grading done before the next class starts. Based on teacher feedback over the last year, numerous options are available to customize ZipGrade to meet different classroom needs.

--------------------------------------------------------
* Free answer sheets available in several formats and sizes (up to 100 question answer sheets)
* Works without internet connectivity. Data will sync whenever a connection is found (optional).
* Uses student ID numbers or written name of student for reporting.
* Knows when a paper is in viewfinder and sufficiently in focus to grade. No buttons to press while grading!
* Students may use pen or pencil. Handles erasures and white out well.
* Combination answers of up to 3 letters allow for up to 31 answers for each question-- great for matching portions!
* Companion website (www.zipgrade.com), allows additional functionality and reporting once a free ZipGrade Cloud user is created:
- Secure backup of all graded papers and data
- Import Student Rosters
- Manage Student and Class Information
- Export Quiz results to CSV or PDF formats
- Download answer sheet packs by class with student information pref-filled
--------------------------------------------------------

Quick Start:
1. Select from multiple answer sheet forms and sizes at ZipGrade.com. Download and print as many copies as you wish.
2. Within the ZipGrade app, press 'New Quiz'
3. Press 'Edit 'Key'. Enter your answer key or scan an answer sheet acting as a key
4. Press 'Scan Papers' to start scanning papers:
* Hold paper on flat surface and align the 4 corner squares in the 4 viewfinders.
* ZipGrade will automatically focus and identify when paper is readable.
* The app will vibrate when paper is graded and provide an instant summary (with links for more detail).
* No buttons to push, leaving your other hand free to turn to the next paper.
5. Review:
* View actual images of scanned papers and make any manual corrections (ie student's crossout out inked circles) in 'Review Papers'
* Get a view of how the entire class did in 'Item Analysis'. Item Analysis includes a drill-through to see alternative answers and which students gave those answers.
* Export results as PDF reports (to print and hand back or post) or CSV files to upload to your gradebook.

As a free download with a 100 scan demo, we'd like you to try ZipGrade to see if it is the right grading app for you. If so, purchase additional time at any point as an in-app purchase. Once purchased, use your subscription on any device you own by logging in with the same ZipGrade Cloud user. Your data and subscription will sync between devices. Many teachers like to scan with their phone, but review with their tablet or desktop computer.

Great for exit tickets, formative assessments, summative assessments, or regular quizzes. By giving teachers the flexibility to grade papers instantly anywhere, ZipGrade provides immediate feedback on current knowledge and can be used to better focus lessons and assignments. Replace your expensive Scantron machine with the technology you're carrying with you already.

We're diligently working to improve the product and need feedback from teachers like you. Write info@zipgrade.com with any feedback or suggestions.

name: Teacher Diary Lesson Planner
description:
Teacher Diary Lesson Planner is a teacher diary app, lesson plan app and secure document vault in one — for teachers, students, and anyone who needs to keep important paperwork safe and organized. Originally designed for Pakistani government school teachers, the app is open to everyone — store your degrees, certificates, service records, daily diary, lesson plans, and any official documents fully encrypted on your device.

Who can use it:
- Government and private school teachers
- College and university students
- Professionals who need to keep degrees and official papers safe
- Anyone looking for a secure, offline document storage app

Why people choose it:
- Keep a daily teaching diary in one tidy place
- Plan classes faster with AI-powered lesson planning from a textbook photo
- Save official documents without depending on cloud storage
- Scan paper documents with your phone camera and store digital copies
- Maintain a complete record of your government service history or student records

Feature highlights:
- Teacher Diary: Record your daily class activities, periods, topics, attendance, and notes. Build a complete day-to-day log of your teaching work that you can revisit anytime.
- Lesson Plans: Create lesson plans manually using the in-app editor, or use AI to auto-generate a complete lesson plan from a single photo of your textbook page. Up to 20 AI-generated lesson plans per month are included.
- Document Saver: Scan your degrees, certificates, joining letters, transcripts, ID cards, and any official documents using your phone camera. Files are saved locally on your device, so you can access them anytime, even without internet.
- Service Record: Store your appointment letters, transfer orders, postings, and complete government service history in one place. Find any old document in seconds.
- Student Documents: Students can save their degrees, transcripts, certificates, ID cards, and exam papers — all in one secure place.
- Backup and Restore: Export your data to a backup file whenever you want, and restore it on a new device. You stay in full control of where your information goes.

Privacy and security:
- All your documents are encrypted with AES-256 encryption.
- Your documents are stored on your device and never uploaded to our servers.
- Internet is required only when using the AI lesson plan feature; all other features work fully offline.
- Lock the app with a PIN or biometric (fingerprint or face) to keep your information private.

A teacher planner, daily diary, lesson plan maker and file locker for degrees and service records — built by Owesi Studio for Pakistan's teachers, students, and everyone who needs a secure document home.

name: Lesson planner
description:
Transform hours of weekly lesson prep into minutes. LessonPlan AI is the ultimate teaching assistant designed to help educators, instructors, and tutors create highly structured, pedagogical lesson plans instantly. Whether you are teaching middle school grammar, introducing new vocabulary, or structuring complex reading comprehension tasks, this tool handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on teaching.

By combining advanced AI with proven educational frameworks, LessonPlan AI generates complete lesson structures—including objectives, target language, materials, and step-by-step activities—tailored perfectly to your specific grade levels and subjects.

**Core Features**

* **Smart AI Generation:** Simply type your topic, paste your instructions, or upload a photo of your textbook. The AI instantly analyzes your requirements and crafts a comprehensive lesson plan tailored to your students' needs.
* **Proven Teaching Frameworks:** Choose from globally recognized pedagogical frameworks including PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production), ECRIF, OHE, ARC, ESA, and Task-Based Learning. Not sure which to use? Let the AI decide the most effective structure for your specific topic.
* **Granular Customization:** Retain complete control over your classroom. Manually edit generated objectives, adjust time durations for specific stages, rewrite teacher and student activities, or explicitly define the target language.
* **Interactive AI Refinement:** Need to make a stage more engaging? Want to simplify the grammar explanation? Use the "Review with AI" chat feature to iteratively tweak and perfect specific sections of your plan.
* **Professional PDF Exports:** Export your finalized plans into beautifully formatted, ready-to-print PDFs. Choose from multiple layout templates including Modern Table, Classic Minimal, and Timeline Editorial. Customize your exports by toggling specific sections like student activities, rationales, and target language on or off.
* **Built-In Calendar & Scheduling:** Organize your teaching week directly within the app. Schedule your generated plans and view your upcoming classes at a glance using the integrated lesson calendar.
* **Smart Library Management:** Save, search, and manage all your past lessons in a centralized library. Never lose a successful lesson structure again.

**Designed for Modern Educators**

LessonPlan AI is built specifically for the workflow of modern teachers. It seamlessly accommodates language instruction by explicitly isolating "Target Language" and skill focuses, while remaining flexible enough for science, history, and general education subjects. Create profiles for different classes, set default durations, and manage your entire teaching workload from a single, intuitive dashboard.

Save time, eliminate Sunday night planning anxiety, and step into the classroom with professional, structured, and engaging lesson plans.

name: Lost Person Behavior
description:
The Lost Person Behavior App is based upon the Search and Rescue (SAR) international gold standard reference tool on where to look for lost and missing persons. Every Public Safety Official needs to know where the missing person might be, what to ask, where to look, and what to do when minutes matter. The app was built around the field needs of Public Safety Officials. No matter how remote the location, the app continues to function since no network connection is required, once installed.

This life-saving information is customized for 41 different subject categories. The categories are organized into a hierarchy of groups including external factors (abductions, aircraft), water incidents (boats and persons in the water), wheeled incidents (ATV, mountain bikes, vehicles, etc.), mental states (autism, dementia, despondent, intellectual disability, mental illness, substance intoxication), children (in five different age groups), eighteen outdoor activities (hiker, hunter, climber, gatherer, skier, etc.).

The app guides the user in selecting the correct subject category by several means. The subject category wizard allows the user to select potential scenarios and then will suggest the best match for the subject category. For example, if a child was riding his bicycle and was then known to be abducted, the user could select Child, Wheel/Motorized, and Abduction; the wizard would suggest using the abduction category. Alternately, the user can go straight to a subject category by using favorites, an alphabetical list, or the hierarchy list. Once the subject category is selected, the Lost Person Behavior App provides the user with:
• behavioral profiles
• tactical briefings
• specific investigative questions
• spatial and survival statistics
• suggestions for initial tasks (reflex tasking).

The all-new tactical briefings distill the statistics and profiles to the key points that every field searcher must know. The more extensive profile, full statistics, and suggested initial tasks assist even the seasoned search planner. The highly detailed questions for the investigation resulted from decades of SAR experience and thousands of missions.

The app even allows you to email a checklist of these critical tasks and interview questions so that you may print them out. The email could also be used for providing remote support or documenting tasks that have been completed.

Determining where to look is one of the major functions of the search statistics, which are now provided in a graphical and tabular format. The statistics from thousands of SAR missions allow the search planner to see where similar previous search subjects were found. The SAR statistics include:
• Distance from the Initial Planning Point
• Elevation model (likelihood of going up, down, or staying at the same elevation)
• Mobility model (how long will the subject keep moving)
• Dispersion angle (given a direction of travel, how well does that predict subject’s location)
• Track Offset model (how far away from a feature such as a road or trail is subject found)
• Find location (at what type of geographic feature was the subject found)
• Scenario (what caused the subject to become missing)
• Survivability overall (what is the overall chance of finding the subject alive or injured)
• Survivability rate (how does survivability rate change in 24-hour increments).

The Lost Person Behavior App can be easily customized to only show the statistical information you actually need. The user can customize for ecoregion, terrain, and urban incidents. The user can view the data in both metric and English units. Several additional helpful tools are built into the app. Contextual help is provided on every page with additional information boxes, which explain every element of the app on the page you need. The information page provides information about the bike wheel model used to describe initial tactical deployment (reflex tasking), a glossary, help, and contact information.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

description:
/!\ THIS IS NOT AN APPLICATION TO TAKE PHOTOS, BUT TO HELP TO PERFORM SETTINGS IN MANUAL MODE ON A CAMERA OR A DEDICATED APPLICATION.

This application will help you to abandon the automatic mode of your cameras that does not do everything and control everything. For more experienced photographers, it can simplify the settings by doing the calculations for you (/!\ The camera must be adjusted manually).

In any case, it is not a magic application to make beautiful pictures every time, but it will allow you to find a basic setting to refine to get the best picture you think.

It is aimed at professional or amateur photographers (basic knowledge is required) and offers the tools to:
- Calculate the alternative/equivalent exposure (manages the ND filter and long exposures)
- Calculate the depth of field, hyperfocal and simulation of Bokeh
- Calculate the field of view
- Calculate the shutter speed to freeze the motion of a subject
- Capture/Photograph sunrise/sunset, the golden hours and the blue hours
- Get the position of the sun, time of sunrise/sunset, golden hour, blue time and monthly calendar
- Capture/Photograph the moon based on the phase of the day
- Capture/Photograph moonlit landscapes
- Get the position of the moon, the hour of moonrise/moonset and the monthly calendar
- Capture/Photograph the stars, the milky way without or with star trails (Simulator)
- Capture/Photograph the northern lights
- Capture/Photograph the lightning and the fireworks
- Calculate the best setting for an EV (exposure value) given
- Calculate distance or aperture with a flash
- Calculate the optimum settings according to the lighting of the place (Light Meter)
- Calculate for the macro photo the possible magnification with a close-up lens or an extension tube
- Calculate the print size
- Time lapse
- Get/Set the characteristics of a camera (sensor size, crop factor, sensor resolution, ISO range, shutter speed range, circle of confusion)

A countdown is available for long exposures.

If this app is right for you, you can switch to Photographer's Companion Pro (no ads with more features).

Do not hesitate to contact me, if you have ideas for changes, improvements, any bugs or for translations (stefsoftware@gmail.com).

name: Sun Ephemeris (Sunset Sunrise)
description:
An ephemeris gives the positions of naturally occurring astronomical objects in the sky at a given time for a given position. The Sun Ephemeris gives you the accurate position of the sun and the moon at any time for any location on earth. The Sun Ephemeris is ideal for landscape, nature, travel and outdoor photographers. It combined a map-based approach to search for any place on the planet with a compass based approach to easily find the direction of the sunset, sunrise, moonset or moonrise.

Key features
• Sunrise, Moonrise, Sunset and Moonset time and azimuth
• Live tracking of Sun and Moon position
• Sun & Moon elevation graph during the day
• Sun and Moon azimuth and elevation at any time during the day
• Use compass to find sun/moon rise/set directions
• Graphical display on a map (Standard, Satellite, Hybrid, Terrain)
• Search for places by name
• Moon distance from earth
• Moon phase and illumination
• Solor noon time, azimuth and elevation

1. Find your location

Use the map view and move it to your current position or use GPS to center the map at you exact location. You can also search for any place in the world by entering its name... Sun and Moon positions are then automatically updated using the choosen location.

2. Set desired time

Use the calendar controls to change the date and time. You can jump from one day to another or from one week to another or use the date time picker to select the date you want. Then you can use the elevation graph to adjust the time within the day. At any time, you can rewind/forward to the current date time which will activate live mode (which follows your phone's clock).

3. Find directions

Use the Compass view to get the direction to Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise or Moonset for the selected location and date.

Enjoy the moment !

name: Exposure Calculator
description:

Why You’ll Love It

• Extreme Ranges: From f/1.0 to f/360 and ISO 0.4 to 3.2M.
• Total Customization: Define your own increments (1, 1/2, or 1/3 stops).
• Presets: Save your go-to setups for instant access.
• Pure & Clean: No ads, no tracking, and no personal data collection.

Stop guessing. Start calculating. Your sensor (and your brain) will thank you.

Plan Every Shot with Precision

Run Production from One Place

Collaborate Your Way (Pro)

- Collaborators work under the owner's plan, so a shared project behaves the same for everyone

Works Where You Do

Powerful Tools for Cinematographers

name: Shot Designer
description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

Stress-Free Execution: Walk into your event knowing the visual documentation is fully planned and accounted for.

Intentional Planning: Focus on the specific photos that matter most to you, from reception details to emotional ceremony highlights.

App Features

• 10 camera angles and 10 shot types, plus focal-length notation from 14mm to 135mm
• Transition tags between shots — CUT, DISSOLVE, WIPE, MATCH CUT, SMASH CUT, FADE
• Blocking overlay — drag movement arrows and PAN, TILT, DOLLY and ZOOM stamps onto a shot

🎞️ ANIMATIC PLAYER
Play the board back at your own pace with a scrubber, a filmstrip and a caption bar showing the shot label, camera angle and lens. Record a scratch dialogue take while it plays.

✅ WHY STORYBOARD

name: ShotLock: GLP-1 Shot Tracker
description:

No more "I'll do it later." No more missed shot days.

ShotLock works with Zepbound®, Mounjaro®, Wegovy®, Ozempic®, Rybelsus®, Saxenda®, Victoza®, Trulicity®, Foundayo®, compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide, retatrutide, GLP-1 pills, and custom medications.

Why does ShotLock exist?

I take semaglutide and have ADHD, so I kept missing my dose. Notifications were just too easy to swipe away. So I built the reminder that won't take no for an answer.

Consistency is what makes GLP-1s work. ShotLock makes consistency automatic.

A REMINDER WITH TEETH

TRACK EVERY DOSE IN SECONDS

SEE WHAT'S IN YOUR BODY

• Know your phase at a glance: Absorbing, At Peak, or Declining

WIDGETS THAT KEEP YOU HONEST
• Shot Clock — a live countdown on your home screen that changes when shot day arrives and the lock arms
• In Your Body — your medication curve and current phase, one glance away, no app open required

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE

YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES

• Your health data stays on your device
• Switching apps? Import your dose history from other GLP-1 trackers in minutes
• Export anytime: PDF summary for your doctor, CSV, or full backup

Want ShotLock to track or sync something it doesn't yet? Request it on our roadmap right from the app — we ship fast.

Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Swedish, Danish, and Norwegian.

ShotLock is for tracking and educational purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your healthcare provider before making any medical decisions or changes to your treatment.

Accessibility API Disclosure

ShotLock uses the Android AccessibilityService API to detect when you open apps that you have selected for monitoring. This allows the app to enforce the ShotLock shield screen when you try to open another app when its time for your injection.

ShotLock uses AccessibilityService only for its core focus features:
• Detecting when a selected gated app is opened
• Redirecting the user to the ShotLock shield screen until they log their scheduled injection.

ShotLock does not use AccessibilityService to read private messages, capture passwords, collect typed text, access financial information, or monitor unrelated activity outside the focus features you enable. You control which apps are shielded and whether AccessibilityService is enabled.

name: Shotlog: Shooting Logbook
description:
A shooting logbook that keeps score while you shoot. Enter each series as you go, in whole points or tenths, and the total is right before you pack up.

Shotlog is for the club shooter with a paper log or a spreadsheet full of numbers and no easy way to tell whether this winter is going better than the last. Air pistol, air rifle, smallbore, service rifle.

KEEPING SCORE
Add a series and tap in the shots. The running total moves as you go, so the arithmetic is done before you leave the range. If you score in tenths, the decimal keypad takes 10.9 in two taps.

SEE WHETHER YOU ARE IMPROVING
Every session gets its own breakdown: score per series, where your shots are landing, totals. Then look across months of them. Filter by discipline, by tag or by date, so you can put a season of competition results side by side, or read a month of practice on its own. This is the part a paper log cannot do, and it is the reason most people keep logging.

TARGETSNAP
Take a photo of the target, paper or screen, and mark where each shot went. You decide what's a ten. Shotlog reads the score from where you put the marks, then measures the group: mean radius, extreme spread, and how far off centre the group sits on the target face. The ring overlay lines itself up with the photo, so you are not dragging it into position by hand. TargetSnap saves the photo with the session, and you can share the scorecard.

DISCIPLINES
Choose your event and the session sets itself up with the right target face and the right scoring, from the ISSF programme to the national ones for Norway, Germany and the USA. Shotlog remembers the discipline you shot last and opens the next session on it.

YOUR FIREARMS
Keep every firearm in one place, each with its own maintenance log, so you know what was last serviced and when. Link a firearm to a session and it remembers which discipline you shoot with it, so the air rifle and the air pistol each open on their own settings.

PAR TIMER
An interval timer built for shooting sports, with presets or intervals you set yourself. One less app on the bench.

EVERYTHING KEPT
Your log is stored in the cloud, so changing phones does not cost you a season. Tag sessions, add notes, mark a session as practice or competition, and export the lot to CSV whenever you want it somewhere else. Light and dark themes.

RANKS
Logged shots add up to a rank that climbs as you go, which is a fair reason to write up the ordinary Tuesday practice you would otherwise let slide.

Shotlog is free to use, and Shotlog Pro unlocks the full set.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. Free, with no subscription required for setlist management.

name: Backing Tracks Guitar Jam Play
description:
Backing Tracks Guitar Jam is an app with more than 740 jam tracks of various styles. There is a lot of jam music for any type of guitar player.

This app is perfect for anyone who wants to master the art of improvisation, solo, rhythm, as well as fully explore the instrument. Practice jamming, learning scales and soloing has never been so easy!

MAKES LEARNING GUITAR FUN
Practice jamming, learning scales and soloing to a jam tracks in keys A, B, C, D, E, F and G right from your device! Our easy-to-read scale charts show you exactly where to put your fingers to start sounding like a pro. See for yourself why thousands of guitarists love this app!

ADVICE:
Try to memorize the track’s chords and study the pentatonic & other scales diagrams closely. Each key has less than 10 boxes! They are not really hard to remember! Finally, you should learn where each box starts for each key. In the end, you will be jamming along with any track effortlessly! More than 700 jam tracks for guitar are at your disposal!

CREATED BY GUITARISTS, FOR GUITARISTS
Practice makes perfect. Backing Tracks Guitar Jam offers an easy-to-use tool to help musicians of all levels master their art. It simulates a real-sounding band that can accompany you as you practice.
This app used by many music students, teachers and some of the world’s top music schools such as Berklee College of Music and Musicians Institute.

BUILD CONFIDENCE
Practicing your scales is the best way to get comfortable with the fretboard. Once your learn the at least 5 different shapes of the pentatonic scale in every key, you'll be able to play along and solo to nearly any song!

IT'S SO EASY TO USE
We created the simplest, fastest and most enjoyable way to practice guitar on a mobile device. Just tap a key and hit play!

FEATURES
☆ About 740 jam tracks in the constantly updating library. More than 400 of them are free!
☆ More than 30 music styles and genres to satisfy any taste: rock, hard rock, blues, jazz, metal, pop, country, soul, funk, acoustic, Indie rock punk rock, reggae, etc.
☆ Tempo change function.
☆ Key change function.
☆ Metronome.
☆ Recording yourself playing & singing along with the accompaniment.
☆ Scale library. Access to 2000+ guitar scales.
☆ Chord library. Access to 5000+ guitar chords.
☆ No more low-quality MIDI playback: app gives you access to more than 740 high-quality backing tracks to accompany you.
☆ A variety of playlist sorting and filtration options.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Select a backing track (choose from the included 30 different accompaniment styles)
2. Adjust tempo and key.
3. Improve your skills by using Chords tab to view the chords used in the track and view the scale diagrams for solo and improvisation.
4. Jam on guitar and make practice fun! Focus on guitar techniques with collections of music from professional guitarists.

FOR RHYTHM AND LEAD PLAYERS
Every track has a listing of chords that are used in the track, along with scale charts - practice rhythm or lead with ease!

WHAT IS A PENTATONIC SCALE?
A pentatonic scale is one consisting of five notes, and that’s it! It is used widely in all genres and styles, and it is one of the most important scales for guitarists.
There are many forms & templates (boxes) for each key. The boxes remain unchanged, except starting positions are different.
Therefore, once you grasp one key, other ones will come much easier!

Problems & feedback?
We strive for excellence, and we're always eager to improve your Guitar Jam experience!
Let us help you in person - contact developer at smakarovpro@gmail.com, and we'll do our best to meet your requests.

name: Tempo: Music Stats & History
description:
🎧 Your music, understood honestly

Tempo is a music stats app that tracks your listening history across different music apps — including Spotify, YouTube Music, and local players — and brings everything into one clear picture.

No Spotify-only limits.

No ads or tracking.

Just your listening history, done right.

top songs and top artists
genre stats and trends
listening time and streaks
daily, weekly, monthly, and all-time stats

Your “Wrapped” doesn’t arrive once a year — it grows as you listen.

Tempo creates Wrapped-style story recaps for any time range — today, this week, this month, or all time.

They’re clean, visual, and easy to share — or keep private if you prefer.

🧠 More than just play counts

Tempo looks at how you listen, not just what you play:

do you finish songs or skip early?
which tracks you keep coming back to?
when you usually listen — late nights, long sessions, short bursts
how your taste changes over time

It’s closer to a music stats journal than a basic tracker.

Spotify, YouTube Music, JioSaavn, Amazon Music, Resso, and local music players.

You can switch apps and your stats still make sense.

🔒 Private by default

no account required
no ads, no analytics
all listening data stays on your device
optional Google Drive backup, fully under your control

Your music history belongs to you — not a server.

🎨 Calm, modern design

Tempo is designed to feel good to open:

smooth animations
colors pulled from album art
story layouts made for sharing

It’s meant to be checked often, not just once a year.

🚧 Built carefully, improving steadily

Tempo is actively evolving.
Feedback matters, bugs are taken seriously, and features grow thoughtfully.

If you’re looking for:

a music stats app
a Spotify Wrapped alternative
YouTube Music stats
a Last.fm alternative that’s personal and private

Tempo was built for that.

name: How to Play in a Band
description:
This is the free version.

With this app you learn in an easy and fun way, how to play in a band.

Using animations in sync with the music that is heard, the lessons show what each instrument must do to sound a certain style of music: Rock, Blues, Funk and Latin Music.

It includes thirty lessons for Guitar, Piano/Keyboards, Electric Bass and Drums on the following contemporary music styles:

- Rock (10)
- Blues (10)
- Funk (5)
- Latin Music (5)

Each lesson is integrated by four sections.

- You will see animations that visually show you how to play your part on your instrument.

- You will see animations of the notes on the staff to help you understand how to read music in an easy way, while you play.

- You can listen the whole band to get an idea of the final result.

- You can play at a slow speed and just listen to your instrument.

- You can play it at normal speed.

- When you are ready go to the “d” section and play it while you listen the rest of the band. You have to integrate your part to the ensemble.

- While practicing you can click on the bar from which you want to repeat.

Click on the icon of the instrument you want to practice, at the bottom of the main page, to find out how to study each lesson.

The best way to approach these materials is to have a band with your friends and together practice each of the 30 lessons that this app presents. Once you have worked through the 30 lessons, you can download the app for each instrument that contains 40 additional lessons (70 in total). Just click the blue arrow icon on the main page to download the app for your favorite instrument.

If you don't have someone to play with in a band, each lesson has a “d” section where you listen to the other instruments while you play your own part. This gives you the experience of playing within an ensemble, whether you play Guitar, Piano/Keyboards, Bass, or Drums.

This app is useful not only for those who want to play in a band, but also for those who want to know what makes a musical style sound like it. What does a bass player have to do for something to sound like Blues or like Latin Music. What are the main rhythmic characteristics of Funk or Rock. What should a drummer do when asked to play a Blues rhythm or a Cha cha chá. How the guitar and piano/keyboard should interact, and so on. These are fundamental aspects for any musician, be it a performer, an arranger or a songwriter. The exercises in this app will help to have a clear idea of the aforementioned aspects.

The most common elements in each style are used and they are presented in ascending order in terms of their degree of difficulty.

name: BANDZONE
description:
The BANDZONE online service lets you stay on top of gigs, rehearsals, song info, setlists, essential files, and more—all from your desktop or mobile device.

The BANDZONE app acts as a mobile extension of your BANDZONE account, providing on-the-go access to all your band’s information—perfect for checking or updating details away from your computer.



KEY FEATURES


-- Easy Event, Availability, and Absence Planning --

Organize gigs, rehearsals, and other events in a shared calendar, with availability feedback from all members and all relevant data in one place. The integrated absences calendar for your band members makes event planning even more streamlined. Whether you’re organizing a show or booking studio time, every band member stays informed via a personal band calendar that can be synced with most calendar apps.


-- Centralized Song and Setlist Management --

Store both general and personal song info, generate engaging setlists from your song library, and link them to events—keeping everyone in sync before stepping on stage. You can also anonymously vote on which songs to rehearse next, making sure everyone enjoys the band’s setlist and avoiding any personal “no-go” songs. Assigning instruments to each song helps optimize the setlist, reducing stress caused by frequent instrument changes on stage.


-- File Storage and Access --

Keep essential documents, lyrics, recordings, and other band resources like logos, press info, or tech riders organized and accessible. Files are stored where they belong, whether that’s with the band, specific songs, events, or venues. Files can even be made publicly accessible for quick sharing with people outside the band. BANDZONE’s storage feature ensures that everyone has access to what they need, wherever they are.


-- Clear Interface --

The simple dark or light interface features clear color coding, intuitive usage patterns, and a “one-click-away” approach for most actions. BANDZONE is designed to be user-friendly, even for less tech-savvy band members, with advanced features and settings placed subtly in the background or limited to band admins.




WHY BANDZONE?

The BANDZONE online service is built by musicians for musicians, with a deep understanding of the complexities of band management. With a focus on clarity and simplicity, BANDZONE minimizes the time spent on coordination, allowing bands to focus on what matters most: creating music and rocking the stage!




WHY NOT?

BANDZONE is not the right fit if you’re looking for a lyrics/sheet music app for live performance or if you definitely need offline functionality, as these features are not available (yet…).




HOW?

Log in with your existing BANDZONE online service credentials or create a free account directly in the app and try it with your entire band for 32 days (after that, you’ll need a full band access).

name: djay - DJ App & AI Mixer
description:
*** Now with Spotify integration ***

djay transforms your Android device into a full-featured DJ system. Seamlessly integrated with Spotify and Apple Music, djay gives you direct access to millions of songs. You can perform live, remix tracks on-the-go, or let the AI-powered Automix create a seamless mix for you automatically. Whether you are a professional DJ or a beginner who just loves to play with music, djay offers you the most intuitive yet powerful DJ experience on Android.

MUSIC LIBRARY

• Spotify: Millions of tracks + your own playlists (Spotify Premium subscription)
• Apple Music: 100+ million tracks, your personal library in the cloud
• djay Music: Thousands of DJ-ready tracks from top artists and trending genres — included for free!
• TIDAL: Millions of tracks, high quality sound (TIDAL DJ Extension)
• SoundCloud: Millions of underground and premium tracks (SoundCloud Go+)
• Beatport: Millions of electronic music tracks
• Beatsource: Millions of open-format music tracks
• Local Music: all the music stored on your device

AUTOMIX

Lean back and listen to an automatic DJ mix with stunning, beat-matched transitions. The AI-powered Automix intelligently identifies rhythmic patterns including the best intro and outro sections of songs to keep the music flowing.

NEURAL MIX™ Stems

• Isolate vocals, drums, and instruments of any song in real-time

BEAT MAKER & REMIX TOOLS

• Sequencer: create beats on top of your music live
• Looper: remix your music with up to 48 loops per track
• Beat-matched sequencing of drums and samples
• Extensive content library with hundreds of loops and samples.

PRE-CUEING WITH HEADPHONES

Preview and prepare the next song through headphones. By enabling djay’s Split Output mode or by using an external audio interface you can pre-listen to songs through headphones independently from the mix that goes through the main speakers for live DJing.

DJ HARDWARE INTEGRATION

• Bluetooth MIDI: AlphaTheta DDJ-FLX-2, Hecules DJ Control Mix Ultra, Hercules DJ Control Mix, Pioneer DJ DDJ-200
• USB Midi: Pioneer DJ DDJ-WeGO4, Pioneer DDJ-WeGO3, Reloop Mixtour, Reloop Beatpad, Reloop Beatpad 2, Reloop Mixon4

ADVANCED AUDIO FEATURES

• Key lock, time-stretching, pitch shifting
• Real-time stem separation
• Mixer, Filter, and EQ controls
• 50+ Audio FX: Echo, Flanger, Crush, Gate, and more
• Crossfader FX
• Looping & Cue Points
• Automatic BPM and key detection
• Auto gain
• Colored waveforms

Note: djay for Android is designed to run on the Android operating system. However, due to the wide range of Android devices on the market, not all features of djay may be supported on every device. For example, Neural Mix requires an ARM64-based device and is not supported on older devices. Additionally, some Android devices do not support external audio interfaces, including those integrated into certain DJ controllers.

The optional PRO subscription allows you to subscribe once and use djay Pro across all your devices, including access to all PRO features, as well as 1000+ loops, samples, and visuals.

A supported streaming subscription and an internet connection are required to access songs from a streaming service in djay. No recording available for streamed songs. Neural Mix cannot be used when streaming from Apple Music or Spotify. Specific songs may not be available or accessible on your account or in your country. Streaming service availability and pricing may vary depending on country, currency and service.
