name: IMSLP Practice
description:
IMSLP is the Petrucci Music Library — the public-domain collection of classical scores that musicians have relied on since 2006. This app puts it on your device, and gives you somewhere to work on it.

FIND A SCORE
Search by work, composer or instrument, or browse a composer's catalogue the way you would a shelf. Open anything straight away, or download it and keep it. Once a score is on your device it stays there, and it opens with no connection at all.

MARK IT UP
Annotate with a stylus or your finger — fingerings, bowings, cuts, a reminder for the next rehearsal. Your marks stay with the score.

PRACTICE ON IT
A metronome and a chromatic tuner sit in the same window as the music, so you never put the score down to reach them. Record a take while you play, then listen back against the page you were reading.

KEEP TRACK
Build practice plans, log what you worked on, and see where the time actually went.

ORGANISE
Group scores into setlists for a concert or a lesson, and into collections for everything else. Put them in the order you play them, and they open that way.

BRING YOUR OWN
Import PDFs, photograph a printed part, or bring a forScore backup across. Your existing library comes with you.

HANDS FREE
Optional head-gesture page turning, so you can keep both hands on the instrument. It uses the front camera, it is off until you turn it on, and nothing leaves the device.

MEMBERSHIP
A free account holds ten scores and ten hours of recordings. An IMSLP membership lifts both limits, removes the download wait, lets you upload your own recordings, and opens the commercial recordings. It also keeps IMSLP itself free and open for everyone who reads from it.

name: Note Rush: Learn to Read Music
description:
Learn to Read Music with Note Rush! Note Rush boosts your note reading speed and accuracy, building a strong mental model of where each written note is on your instrument. Now even better with Note Rush: 2nd Edition!

How it Works
---------------------------
Note Rush is like a virtual flash card deck for all ages that listens to you play each note, giving instant feedback and awarding stars based on speed and accuracy of note identification.

Race against the clock to improve your performance or hide the timer to gently engage those just starting out with the staff.

Includes built-in levels for piano and a range of other instruments as well as custom level design.


What makes Note Rush Different?
---------------------------
- Play On Your Instrument
Note reading is best learnt in the context of how you identify and play each note - on your acoustic or MIDI instrument.

- Designed for Teachers
...and not as a replacement for them! Create fully customizable note sets and easily send them home to students.

- Fun Themes
Engage with fun themes that don't get in the way of learning, or opt for traditional notation.


Landmarks: The best way to learn your notes
---------------------------
Note Rush fits with all teaching methods, whether you favor a purely intervallic approach or use traditional mnemonics! We promote learning key landmark notes then reading adjacent notes intervallically for the best results in learning to read piano notation.

Note Rush features a unique landmarks-based hints system (optional) that highlights nearby landmark notes to read intervallically from. Over time students naturally move from reliance on landmarks to a more intrinsic staff-to-keyboard association.


Preset and Custom Levels
---------------------------
Use preset note ranges or create your own set of levels to suit your teaching style. Create a personalized level to target a particular student’s needs.

- Individual Note Selections
- Sharps and Flats
- Treble, Bass or Grand Staff (alto and tenor coming soon)
- Up to Six Ledger Lines
- Send custom note reading drills using App Links or QR Codes

name: Baby Tracker - Newborn Log
description:
Baby Tracker brings a baby feeding tracker, sleep tracker and diaper log together in one easy-to-use newborn diary. Record breastfeeding, bottles, pumping, growth, health and milestones, and share your baby’s daily routine with caregivers.

Designed by busy parents, for busy parents, it keeps everyday tracking quick and clear—from late-night nursing to the first steps.

WHAT’S NEXT

One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.

What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:

• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper

Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.

What’s Next is optional. All core tracking features remain free.

GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE

Use What’s Next alongside your baby’s own cues and your judgment—not as a fixed schedule or instruction.

What’s Next is not medical advice. Contact a healthcare professional if you have concerns about your baby’s health, sleep or feeding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

What’s Next cues are created directly on your device. Your baby’s logs aren’t sent to us to generate them.

BABY FEEDING & BREASTFEEDING TRACKER

• Use the breastfeeding timer to track nursing on each breast
• Quickly see which side you last used
• Keep a bottle feeding log for formula and expressed breast milk
• Record solid foods and notes about preferences or reactions
• Review feeding times and your baby’s changing routine

PUMPING & BREAST MILK TRACKER

• Record pumping sessions and milk amounts
• Keep a breast pump log alongside your feeding records

BABY SLEEP TRACKER & NAP LOG

• Record daytime naps and nighttime sleep
• Use the sleep timer to keep a baby sleep log
• Review sleep patterns as your baby’s sleep schedule changes
• Set reminders and alarms
• See personalized What’s Next sleep and wake-up cues

DIAPER TRACKER

• Log wet, dirty and mixed diapers
• Quickly see when the last diaper change occurred
• Keep a diaper log with a clear history of changes

BABY GROWTH TRACKER

• Track weight, height and head circumference
• Follow infant growth charts based on World Health Organization standards

HEALTH & DEVELOPMENT

• Record medications, vaccinations and temperature
• Keep baby health records and notes together
• Use the baby milestone tracker to save first smiles, words and steps
• Add photos and notes to your baby journal

CHARTS & REPORTS

• Review daily, weekly and monthly activity charts
• Recognize patterns across sleep, feeding and diaper records
• Share useful information with caregivers and healthcare professionals

SYNC & SHARING

• Sync baby records across multiple devices
• Keep parents, family members and other caregivers up to date
• Track the same baby together without maintaining separate logs

BABY TRACKER PLUS

Baby Tracker Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription that includes ad-free tracking and personalized What’s Next sleep, feed and diaper cues.

Pricing, billing periods and renewal terms are shown in the app before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription through Google Play.

All core tracking remains free without Plus. Existing purchases, including the one-time Remove Ads purchase, continue to work as before.

Spend less time managing records and more time with your baby.

name: My Baby Tracker: Feeding Sleep
description:
Everything for baby care in one app: feeding, sleep, diapers, growth and development tracker.

Baby daybook: breastfeeding and bottle feeding, sleep schedule, diaper log, weight and height

The first months with your baby are a special time when every day matters for your infant's development. Parents want to understand how their baby eats, how much sleep they get, whether diapers are changed regularly, and if growth is on track. Our baby daybook helps make parenting simple, organized, and calm - from the first days of breastfeeding to establishing feeding and sleep routines.

"My Baby Tracker" is created for parents who want to easily track their baby's feeding, monitor sleep patterns, log diaper changes, and follow their infant's development.

What's inside the app:

Main screen with latest baby data
Convenient dashboard shows all important information about your baby in one place: when was the last breastfeeding or bottle feeding, how much time has passed since last sleep, when the diaper was changed, current infant weight and height. All information at your fingertips - you instantly see your baby's status.

Feeding tracker
Record every feeding: breastfeeding, bottle feeding, or formula. Mark start time and duration, which breast, amount of formula. Feeding timer helps you remember when baby ate last. Statistics show nursing frequency and help establish a feeding routine.

Sleep diary
Log every baby sleep: when fell asleep, how long slept, sleep quality. Sleep tracker shows total daily sleep time and helps build a routine. You'll see if your infant gets enough rest and how sleep patterns change over time.

Diaper tracking
Mark diaper changes and their contents. This is important for monitoring baby health: the number of wet and dirty diapers shows whether the infant is getting enough nutrition and how digestion is working.

Growth and weight
Record measurements of height, weight, head circumference. Growth charts show dynamics and help track how your baby is growing. Compare indicators with norms and share data with your pediatrician.

Growth and weight standards
Built-in standards help understand if baby weight and height correspond to age norms. You see how your infant develops compared to standard indicators for breastfed or formula-fed babies.

Sleep norms by age
Compare your baby's sleep patterns with recommended norms for their age. The app shows how much an infant should sleep at different months and helps understand if your baby is getting enough rest.

Development calendar
Track important milestones in baby development: when started holding head, rolling over, sitting, crawling. Development calendar suggests what skills appear at each age and helps not miss important moments.

Teething order
Mark the appearance of baby's first teeth and track teething order. Teething calendar shows typical sequence and timing of infant tooth appearance, helps prepare for this period.

Statistics and charts
All records about feeding, sleep, diapers are collected into visual charts. You see baby's daily routine, nursing frequency, total sleep time and can notice changes in development. This helps better understand infant needs.

Notes and reminders
Add notes about baby's wellbeing, mood, feeding or sleep specifics. Set reminders for next feeding or sleep time so you don't miss important moments.

"My Baby Tracker" - your reliable parenting assistant. Everything you need to track feeding, sleep, diapers, and development - in one place.

name: Baby: Breastfeeding Tracker
description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Email us your comments and suggestions, and we'll implement them as soon as possible!

PUMPSTASH+ is a one-time purchase. Basic logging stays free forever.

PumpStash is the exclusive pumping tracker built for return-to-work moms and exclusive pumping (EP) parents who manage a real freezer stash. It is not a general baby tracker. It does one job: keep you ahead of your milk.

name: Breastfeeding Newborn tracker
description:
The simplest program to track breastfeeding, pumping, bottle feeding, solid food consumption, diapers, sleep schedule, height and weight, and more.

With the click of a button your feedings and baby care history will be stored in the app. You will have an easy-to-maintain history of your baby’s growth.

In the application, you can share baby's data with your partner, relatives, or nanny. Syncing data between multiple devices is available for free.

The birth of a baby is a miracle that fills your heart with joy! A mother’s life changes dramatically with the birth of her baby. It is so important for a mother and her newborn baby to establish a comfortable breastfeeding relationship. Moms need to keep track of which breast to offer her baby, how long the baby suckles at each breast, the number of times the baby breastfeeds each day, how many wet diapers and bowel movements the baby has, how long and frequently the baby sleeps, as well as the baby’s weight and growth. All of this information is important for the self-assessment of breastfeeding and for assessing the growth of the child. Having this information easily accessible will be extremely useful when visiting with your pediatrician or lactation consultant.

It is important to record all of this data. Do not rely on your memory, because even the most organized mothers are often lost in the sea of information about their newborn.

Use the features of the Breastfeeding application.

Breastfeeding and pumping:
- record the time and quantity of feedings and / or pumpings;
- note which breast was fed or pumped last to ensure starting new feeding/pumping on the opposite breast;
- record the duration of feeding / pumping;
- pause feeding / pumping, if necessary;
- brief feedings / pumpings, or those that occur within a short period of time, are grouped into one feeding / pumping event
- quickly add feeding / pumping session that was similar to the most recent but update with current time
- use the maximum duration of feeding setting and the application will stop recording the feeding / pumping at the set time if you are unable to press stop

Liquids:
- consider all of your child’s fluid intake (water, expressed breast milk, formula, juice, etc.);
-track your child’s reactions to new fluids and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers;
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Feeding (solid food):
- add solid foods as your child begins eating them (cereal, vegetables, fruits, meat, fish);
- track your child’s reactions to these new foods and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Sleep:
- record the time and duration of your baby’s sleep each day so you can better plan your day;
- compare your baby’s sleep habits with recommended sleep guidelines


Diapers:
- track the number of your baby’s wet and / or dirty diapers. This information is crucial for noticing signs of dehydration, constipation, and diarrhea and alerting the child’s pediatrician if necessary.

Measurements:
- track height and weight to evaluate your baby’s development;

Other features:
- edit or delete events as needed;
- set reminders for various events;
- use the application in your native language (more than 40 languages available);
- select your preferred units of measurement (ounces or milliliters);
- browse graphs;
- view statistics;
- enter data for several children and twins;
- backup all of your data;
and more!

PRO-version
- disable advertising;
- install widgets for quick viewing and launch;
- auto backup every 24 hours;
- export to Excel


We are constantly working to improve the application. Write to us with questions and suggestions.

Enjoy watching your healthy baby grow!

name: The Wonder Weeks - Baby Leaps
description:
The world’s No. 1 baby app! Understand why your baby cries more at certain times, isn't himself or herself and... what you can do to help.

During our research, which began in 1971 with Jane Goodall and the chimpanzees in Tanzania, we discovered that babies are more prone to cry and to be clingy or cranky from time to time. This behavior was shown to be related to a leap in the baby's mental development. More specifically, babies go through 10 mental leaps in the first 20 months of their life. A leap may be tough, but it's a positive thing: it gives your baby the opportunity to learn something new.

- See when a leap starts and ends thanks to a personalized leap schedule
- Be automatically notified when a leap is about to start

- Discover the new skills your baby develops with each leap
- Stimulate your baby's new skills with 77 playtime games
- Keep track of your baby's development in your personal diary
- Link the app to your partner's app to keep track of your baby's developments together
- Share your experiences and ask questions in the forum
- Watch fun and interesting videos about parenting
- Complete fun polls and find out what other parents think about certain topics


Our mission is to help parents gain confidence in the face of the greatest leap in life: having a baby. We take a candid look at parenting, shed light on all sides and are there for all parents. We can all help each other and learn from each other.

Millions of parents before you have already followed, supported and stimulated the 10 leaps in the mental development of their babies. It's not a coincidence that we have been one of the best-selling baby apps worldwide for many years!

Care is shared, visible, and organized so nothing gets missed. Families stay aligned, reduce stress, and spend less time tracking updates—and more time supporting the people they love.

SHARED MEDICATION TRACKER
Log doses, set reminders, and reduce “Did Dad take his meds?” anxiety. Everyone in the care circle sees what matters, without turning care into a spreadsheet.

SHARED CAREGIVER CALENDAR & APPOINTMENTS
Put appointments in one shared calendar in the care hub so siblings, helpers, and primary caregivers stay aligned. Great when you’re coordinating doctor visits, therapies, and visits across cities.

SHARED TASKS, CARE CHECKLISTS & DUE DATES
Turn vague worries into a shared task list: errands, follow-up items, home safety tasks, and care plan steps with notes and due dates everyone in the circle can act on together.

SHARED CARE LOGS, VITALS & HEALTH TREND CHARTS
Log blood pressure, pulse/heart rate, blood sugar, temperature, mood, and daily notes in one shared care hub. Health trend charts help your family spot patterns over time and bring clearer context to appointments.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS
Keep insurance cards, IDs, medication lists, and visit notes in one secure place in the hub, so the right file is there in stressful moments.

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS
See recent activity across medications, tasks, appointments, care logs, and documents. Fewer repeated questions; clearer accountability for everyone in the care circle helping Mom or Dad.

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall. Free is your hub as admin. Inviting family to edit together is Premium (trial when eligible). Paid plans also add more loved one profiles, more document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history.

PRIVACY & TRUST
No ads in the app — we’re supported by optional Premium subscriptions, not banner ads. Your family’s information matters; review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

Caregiver supports care coordination; it does not replace professional medical advice. Always follow your health professional’s guidance.

description:
Connected Caregiver: Family caregiving made easier

Download now to get Care Essentials FREE—your digital family caregiving assistant! Keep track of appointments, notes, and medication information, plus collaborate and communicate with others in your Loved One’s care circle—all in one app.

Connected Caregiver equips family caregivers with the tools and technology to make managing details and monitoring the safety and health of their loved one easier, freeing them up to focus on what matters most.

CARE ESSENTIALS | FREE

Manage the Loved One(s) You Care For:
Care Essentials allows you to manage your parent(s) / Loved One(s) through the Connected Caregiver app.

Care Circle Management:
Invite siblings and anyone else involved in caregiving (including paid caregivers) to use the app (free of charge to those you invite). Create a one-stop hub of key info for everyone (meds, doctor lists, health documents like insurance cards). Coordinate care, add members to certain events, and create group chats or direct messages.

Medication Management:
A list of your Loved One’s medication at your (and the Care Circle’s) fingertips. Create automated medication reminders for your Loved One, stay on top of doses & refills, and even be alerted to potentially dangerous interactions between medications.

Document Storage:
Upload images of key documents like insurance cards, medical records (test results, appointment notes) and more — all with HIPAA compliance so you can use the app safely and securely.

Mood Surveying:
Get a quick snapshot of how your Loved One is perceiving their own health by sending a daily “How are you feeling?” survey — and track trends over time.

Dedicated Calendar:
Track events like doctor’s appointments, family meals, gatherings your Loved One plans to attend, and more — using a calendar within the app that’s dedicated to your Loved One’s care.

Manual Health Vital Tracking (or upgrade to automatic tracking):
Use the app to manually log your Loved One’s vitals so you can see trends over time. Cell-enabled remote vitals tracking devices are available for just $5/month extra per device (also requires one-time device purchase). Options include: Blood Pressure Monitor; Digital Weight Scale; Pulse Oximeter (to measure Blood Oxygen); Glucometer.

Custom Notifications:
Set your preferred notification sequence — push notification, text, or email — and stay up to date with the most important information.

SAFETY+ | $45/month
Visit myconnectedcaregiver.com/safety to sign-up.

Get EVERYTHING from Care Essentials, plus greater peace of mind with real-time emergency alerts and fall detection through the discreet and trusted Rely-X device (FREE for a limited time — a $119 value).

Senior Medical Alerts:
With the press of a button, your Loved One can instantly alert you and our 24/7 monitoring team to get the help they need. Our Monitoring Center caters to more than 1.3M subscribers with 3 monitoring locations to ensure no communication drops. The average call response time is just 9-seconds after the button is pressed.

Fall Detection for Seniors:
Programmed to detect falls and immediately call for help, giving you peace of mind when you can’t be with them. If a fall is detected, our agents will call the Loved One via the 2-way cell enabled Rely-X device and send emergency help if needed. As the caregiver you can also choose to be notified. See a history of recorded falls within the app.

GPS Location & Geofencing:
GPS monitoring and nationwide 4G cellular coverage ensures you’ll always know where your Loved One is located. You can even set up geofencing to be notified if your Loved One exits or enters a certain location.

First Motion & Step Tracking:

name: Caregiver Planner: Elder Care
description:
Caring for an aging parent is never a one-person job. When reminders, doctor visits, and the "did anyone pick up the prescription?" texts pile up in a chaotic group chat, something always slips. Home Care Organizer gives your whole family one calm, shared place to run it all.

This is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not medical advice. It helps you plan, remind, share, and keep track, so the person you love gets steady, coordinated care, and nobody has to carry every detail in their head.

ONE SHARED PLACE, NOT SIX SCATTERED APPS

Instead of a whiteboard, a notes app, three calendars, and a group text nobody scrolls back through, everything lives together. Anyone helping can open the app and instantly see what is done, what is coming up, and who is on it. No more "I thought you had that."

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Build a care profile for your loved one, with name, relationship, and simple notes, so everyone shares the same starting point.

- Keep a shared task list. Add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic," assign them to a specific family member, set a due date, and check them off together.

- Track every appointment in one calendar. Add doctor and specialist visits with the provider, location, and notes, then set a reminder (15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, or a day before) so nobody misses one.

- Set medication reminders. Add each medication and the times you want a nudge, then log each one as taken or skipped to keep a clear adherence record. The app reminds you of the time only, and never suggests, adjusts, or comments on what or how much to take.

- Keep a shared care log. Note visits, calls, and updates ("Visited this afternoon, ate well, in good spirits"). Over time it becomes your family's shared memory of how things are really going.

- Save the numbers that matter. Keep the doctor, pharmacy, nurse, and family contacts together so anyone can reach the right person fast.

- Generate prep checklists. Pick a situation, a specialist visit, hospital discharge, home-safety walkthrough, organizing medications, a caregiver rotation, new-diagnosis questions, arranging in-home help, or gathering documents and legal paperwork, and get an organizational checklist: questions to ask, papers to bring, and tasks to divide up. Coordination only, never diagnosis or treatment.

FREE TO START, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED

Jump straight in as a guest, with no sign-up wall. On the free plan you can organize care for one loved one on your own device: unlimited tasks, appointments, and care-log entries, medication reminders, saved contacts, and a sample prep checklist. It is a genuinely useful single-caregiver organizer, at no cost.

GO PRO WHEN THE FAMILY NEEDS TO SHARE

The moment you want to bring siblings and other helpers in, Pro unlocks:

- Cloud family sharing, so tasks, calendar, and the care log stay in sync in real time across everyone's phones.
- Unlimited medication reminder profiles and full history.
- Unlimited prep checklists for every new situation.
- Multiple care recipients, to coordinate for more than one loved one.
- Export your care log and appointment history as a PDF for your own records.
- No ads.

Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription, because caregiving is a season of life. The core organizer stays free, and Pro is there when the whole family needs to be on the same page.

A NOTE ON WHAT THIS APP IS

Home Care Organizer helps you organize and coordinate care. It does not provide medical, dosing, or health advice. For any medical question, please consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Get everyone on the same page, so nobody is guessing, and nobody is carrying it alone.

description:
This senior app improves a loved ones physical and mental health and well-being by helping them:

This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

This senior safety app uses phone/tablet sensors and home IoT sensors to monitor and detect problems. It alerts family and caregivers in the care-group. Great for senior safety. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

[7] Elderly launcher app
This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

SUMMARY - This senior app is designed to promote senior safety, senior health, and senior living. The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. name: Elder Care: Pill Reminder Log
description:
Elder Care is a free medicine reminder and personal health record built for older adults and the family members who look after them. Big text, plain words, one-tap answers — and everything stays on your own phone.

NEVER MISS A DOSE
• Reminders at the exact time you set — not "sometime in the next 15 minutes"
• Answer from the notification: "I took it" or "Remind me later"
• Every schedule real prescriptions use: daily, set weekdays, every few days, monthly, every N hours, cycles like 21 days on / 7 off, and as-needed
• Steroid tapers and short courses: the dose steps down on its own and reminders stop on the last day
• "With food / before food / empty stomach" printed on the reminder itself
• Double-dose check: if you already took it minutes ago, the app asks before recording another
• Skip with a reason ("felt unwell", "ran out", "doctor said stop") — the reason goes into your doctor report
• Refill warnings in days, not just tablets — and a warning if a course cannot be finished with what is left
• Reminder health check: send yourself a test alert, and get step-by-step battery fixes for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, OnePlus, realme, TECNO and more

SCAN A LABEL INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at the box. Name, strength, form and directions are read on the phone — nothing is uploaded — and you check them before saving.

TRACK HOW YOU ARE DOING
• Blood pressure, blood sugar, pulse, oxygen, temperature, weight, breathing, sleep, water, steps
• Pain and mood on a faces scale — no arithmetic while you are hurting
• mg/dL or mmol/L, kg or lb, °C or °F — your choice
• Trend charts with the commonly published range shown for context
• Symptom diary with the medicine you suspect — the app counts and dates them for your appointment, and never claims a cause

KEEP YOUR PAPERS
Photograph prescriptions, lab reports, X-rays, hospital letters and vaccination cards. Search them by the words on the page. Lab values are read off a scanned report and offered for you to confirm — with the range your own laboratory printed.

LAB RESULTS
130 common tests — HbA1c, creatinine, cholesterol, TSH, vitamin D and more — with history and charts per test.

READY FOR THE DOCTOR
• Doctor report PDF: what was taken, what was missed and why, readings, symptoms
• Readings export as PDF or CSV, choose the dates per metric
• Visit preparation: what to mention and what to ask, assembled from your own record
• Family update: a short plain-text message for whoever helps you
• Wallet-sized emergency card with allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts

MADE FOR OLDER EYES AND HANDS
Four text sizes, stronger-contrast mode, dark mode, full-width buttons, no long-press secrets, spelled-out "Required" instead of a tiny asterisk, and every date written out in words.

TWO PEOPLE, ONE PHONE
Keep separate records for yourself and the person you care for, and switch with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No analytics. No ads. No subscription. Your record is encrypted on this phone and the key stays in your phone's own secure keystore. Sharing a report, a card or a backup is a file you hand over yourself. Uninstalling removes everything.

Elder Care records what you tell it and shows it back to you. It does not diagnose, dose or replace your doctor or pharmacist.

Free forever. Made with care for the people who need it most.

DoseBuddy is a medication reminder app that helps you stay consistent with every dose reminder and keep your medication schedule on track. Whether you manage daily prescriptions, vitamins, or short-term treatments, DoseBuddy reduces missed doses with reliable alerts, clear logging, and fast setup.

A Smarter Medication Schedule:
Create a personalized medication schedule in minutes with exact times, frequencies, and instructions for each medicine. DoseBuddy gives you dependable reminders, adaptive snooze options, and persistent notifications for important doses.

When routines change, you can quickly update your plan so your medication schedule always stays accurate.

- Custom recurring reminders for prescriptions, supplements, and as-needed meds
- Flexible alert timing and snooze controls
- Strong prescription reminder support for long-term adherence

Pill Tracker:
DoseBuddy includes a dedicated pill tracker for daily adherence. Mark doses as taken, skipped, or delayed in one tap, then review a clean history anytime.
The pill tracker helps you spot patterns early, improve consistency, and stay prepared for doctor visits.

- Pill tracker history with timestamps
- Pill tracker views for missed and completed doses
- Better refill and adherence visibility

Medication Tracker & Log:
Use DoseBuddy as a full medication tracker with detailed logs for each dose. Record amount, notes, symptoms, and vitals in one place to keep your care data organized.

The medication tracker timeline helps you connect how you feel with what you took, making follow-ups more productive.

- Complete medication tracker records for daily use
- Calendar-based medication log and history reports
- Shareable summaries for care teams and appointments

Why Choose DoseBuddy?
- Smart alerts built for real-world routines
- Simple organization for any medication plan
- Safety-focused tools, including interaction checks
- Private by default, with optional PIN or biometrics
- QR transfer to move data to a new device seamlessly

Private by Default
No account is required. Your health data stays on your device, not on a remote server. For extra protection, lock the app with biometrics or a PIN.

DoseBuddy Pro: Take Control
- Wear OS Tile: See your next dose at a glance and take quick actions from your watch
- Wear OS Complication: Show upcoming medication info directly on compatible watch faces
- Barcode Scanning: Add medications faster with label scans
- Family Circle: Caregiver alerts with real-time notifications
- Secure Backups: Export and restore via Google Drive or iCloud
- PDF Reports: Detailed medication history for your physician
- Savings: Built-in prescription coupon search

FAQ:
How does DoseBuddy work as a medication reminder?
DoseBuddy sends dependable alerts, recurring schedules, and persistent notifications so you can stay on time with every dose.

Can I use DoseBuddy as a pill tracker?
Yes. The app includes a pill tracker for logging taken, skipped, and delayed doses with full history.

How does the dose reminder feature help me avoid missed doses?
Each dose reminder can be customized with timing and snooze settings, including persistent alerts for critical medications.

Can I set a medication schedule for multiple medications?
Yes. You can manage complex multi-medication routines with different times, frequencies, and instructions.

Is DoseBuddy a prescription reminder app too?
Yes. DoseBuddy supports recurring prescription reminder workflows for both short-term and ongoing treatments.

Important: DoseBuddy is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. It does not provide medical advice. Always follow guidance from your healthcare professional.

WHY FAMILIES, COUPLES & ROOMMATES USE IT

• Shared shopping lists, live — add "milk" on one phone and it's on the other before you've put yours down. Check something off and the whole household knows.
• Store reminders, free for everyone — a shopping list reminder that fires when you arrive at Aldi, Kroger, Costco, Home Depot or any store you add, and only while something is still unchecked. It works even if the app hasn't been opened in days, and it's a low-power geofence, not GPS tracking.
• Tell the household — optionally, when one of you is near the store, the others hear about it, so someone can add the thing they forgot while you're still in the aisle. No coordinates leave anyone's phone; what travels is the store's name and a count.
• Receipt scanner — photograph the receipt and every item and price is read on your phone and saved to the household's spending history. No typing, and the photo never leaves the device.
• Household chores without the nagging — assign tasks, set recurring schedules, or leave a chore open for whoever's around. A chore chart for roommates, a routine for families; either way you can see who did what and when.
• A shared family calendar — appointments, school dates and plans everyone can see, with reminders before they arrive. Subscribe once and it shows up inside Google Calendar, Outlook, or any calendar app that takes a subscription link.
• Organized automatically — items group by department (dairy, produce, hardware and more) so a shopping trip is a straight line, not a scavenger hunt.
• Every phone in the household — everyone stays in sync no matter what they carry, and the full web version is there for keyboard jobs like pasting a 30-item stock-up.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create a household and invite your family, partner or roommates with one link — they tap it and they're in, no code to type.
2. Add a store from any list — type its name and pick the one near you.
3. Get reminded at the store, scan the receipt on the way out, and watch the spending picture build itself.

name: PetLog – Pet Health Journal

Whether your pet suffers from allergies, digestive issues, stress, aging, or simply needs regular check-ups – this app gives you the tools to spot health trends, manage treatments and take better care of your pet.

The app works entirely offline and stores all data locally on your phone. Nothing is sent to the cloud unless you explicitly choose to activate AI analysis. Your privacy and your pet’s data are fully protected.

With PetLog, you can:

– Log meals and water intake, including type of food (dry, wet, homemade, raw)
– Track treats and snacks throughout the day
– Monitor symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhea, itching, or unusual behavior
– Record symptom severity, duration and end time
– Document medications, supplements, dosages and schedules
– Keep a detailed weight history and monitor changes over time
– Use the Bristol stool scale to track bowel movements and digestion
– Track daily stress levels and activity patterns
– Add notes about mood, sleep, hygiene, exercise and more
– Record vet appointments, vaccinations, treatments and diagnoses
– Generate and export PDF reports for your veterinarian
– Use AI-powered insights to detect patterns and potential health issues (optional)
– Track multiple pets in parallel with separate profiles
– Get reminder-free tracking – no login or subscription needed for basic features

PetLog combines the simplicity of a pet diary with the intelligence of a health tracker. It helps you stay organized and proactive. Use it to prepare for vet visits, monitor long-term conditions, or just to better understand your pet’s wellbeing.

Whether your cat has chronic kidney issues, your dog is recovering from surgery, your rabbit needs a specialized diet, or you simply want to be a more mindful and attentive pet parent – PetLog supports you with powerful, customizable features.

This app was created by pet lovers for pet lovers. It is not overloaded with ads or unnecessary functions. Instead, PetLog focuses on what really matters: clear entries, useful data, smart insights and total privacy.

PetLog is perfect for:
– Dog owners tracking food allergies, joint pain or medication routines
– Cat owners monitoring behavior, litter box use or stress-related issues
– Owners of multiple pets who need a clear overview of each animal
– Veterinary clinics looking to recommend a digital journal to clients
– Pet sitters and caretakers who want to keep detailed records

Use PetLog daily or as needed. The more you log, the better you understand your pet. Patterns emerge, health improves, and decisions become easier.

Don’t guess what’s going on – know it. PetLog helps you give your animal the care it deserves.

Download PetLog today and start tracking your pet’s health with confidence.

You can track food intake, set feeding schedules, and monitor your pet's weight to ensure they're getting the right amount of food.

Pet Behavior Tracking: Behavior issues can be a sign of underlying health problems or can cause health problems themselves. Clio's behavior tracking feature allows you to monitor your pet's behavior patterns, so you can identify any potential issues early. You can track things like barking, scratching, and chewing, and set reminders for training or behavior modification sessions.

Pet Activity Tracking: Just like humans, pets need regular exercise to stay healthy. Clio's activity tracking feature allows you to monitor your pet's activity levels and ensure they're getting enough exercise. Medical History Management: Keeping track of your pet's medical history can be a daunting task. Multi-Pet Profile Management: If you have multiple pets, it can be challenging to keep track of everyone's health and wellness. Clio's multi-pet profile management feature makes it easy to create and manage profiles for each of your pets, so you can track their health and wellness individually.

Vaccine Tracking: Vaccinations are an essential part of your pet's health care. Clio's vaccine tracking feature allows you to monitor your pet's vaccination status and set reminders for upcoming vaccinations. name: Pet Food Calculator
description:
From calculating food portions to tracking meals, weight, and toilet habits, this app helps you manage everyday care for your dogs and cats.

The right amount of food varies depending on your pet’s body condition, life stage, and food. Calculate estimated daily calorie needs and feeding amounts based on weight, BCS (Body Condition Score), and other factors.

Choose a saved calculation and record how much you fed and when. Keep track of which calculation you used for each meal to support consistent feeding management.

FEATURES

• Calculate estimated daily calorie needs and feeding amounts based on weight, BCS, life stage, and food calorie content.
• Save multiple calculations and select one when recording a meal.
• Record the amount fed, the date and time, and the calculation used.
• Review feeding and toilet records by day.
• Track body weight and changes over time.
• Manage separate profiles and records for multiple pets.
• Save records to the cloud with an email-verified account.
• Delete calculations and records you no longer need.
• View the academic papers and guidelines referenced for the calculations.
• Available in Japanese, English, and Chinese.

WHO IS IT FOR?

• Pet owners who want an estimate of how much to feed.
• Anyone who wants to record daily feeding amounts and times.
• Pet owners calculating portions when changing food.
• Anyone who wants to review weight and toilet records in one place.
• Households managing records for multiple pets.
• Pet owners who want to understand the basis of feeding calculations.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

The app provides estimated feeding amounts for reference only. It does not replace veterinary diagnosis or individualized nutritional advice. Appropriate portions vary depending on age, health, activity level, and other factors.

Consult a veterinarian before making sudden changes to food intake, if you notice concerning weight changes, or if your pet has an existing medical condition. Seek veterinary guidance for puppies, kittens, senior pets, and pets that are pregnant or nursing.

With our medical alert app, you can add a new medicine to your virtual medication list in just seconds. Your medical assistant TOM does the rest for you. With our pill reminder app, you will forget about any registration, charge, and advertising!
User-friendly and completely anonymous: the integrated medicine reminder will notify you whenever it’s time to take your pills, tablets, and other meds, making your daily activities much simpler. Now for measurements and activities as well, including graphs and statistics showing everything at a glance.

Developed by patients, for patients
The TOM medication reminder with the integrated medicine list and medication log is so practical and user-friendly because its developers know from personal experience which requirements a digital medication tracker and scheduler need to meet. The pill reminder is the ideal solution for simply and efficiently managing treatment regimens for a wide range of conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, Crohn’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, cardiovascular diseases, multiple sclerosis, and more.

Key features of the medical alert app at a glance
• Easy to use thanks to dialogue-based design: TOM asks and you reply – without filling in forms or having to tediously search through menus
• Add new meds, measurements, or activities quickly and easily
• Send or print PDFs of monthly health reports
• Medication log and medicine list with high-quality graphs and statistics for all pills taken, health measurements, and activities
• Feature for uploading your own pictures of med packaging
• Digital cabinet provides a complete medication list that can be printed out as a PDF file
• Pill reminder with alarm to refill prescriptions before they run out or expire
• Fully integrated treatment management that combines a record of meds you have taken with your health measurements (blood pressure and weight, for example) and activities (running, yoga, etc.)
• Keep your medication log up to date: pills are taken daily, medicine intervals of several days or hours, single doses or taken sporadically
• Suitable for managing the treatment of a wide range of conditions and diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, multiple sclerosis, stroke, asthma, etc.)
• Modern solution for managing medicine in order to ensure they are taken at the right time and to monitor the progress of your treatment
• Medication reminder if you forget to take your pills
• Maximum data security thanks to the anonymous use of the TOM pill reminder and two-way encryption

Privacy and data protection are top priority
Using the TOM medication tracker and scheduler is completely anonymous: no registration with personal details is required. The information you enter is linked only to a randomly generated ID number. Even TOM does not have access to this number, as it is also cryptographically protected. In addition, all communication with the TOM app is encrypted in both directions.

Download the TOM medication reminder on your smartphone and let the simple medication tracker and scheduler add some extra freedom to your daily life. Never forget to take your tablets, pills, or medicine again thanks to the pill reminder and medicine tracker. Suitable for a wide range of conditions, including high blood pressure, asthma, stroke, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, etc.

SUBMIT YOUR FEEDBACK TO HELP IMPROVE TOM
Thank you for using the TOM medical alert app. Your feedback helps us to further develop the TOM medication reminder and offer you maximum benefit. We always encourage you to send your suggestions and ideas to support@tommedications.com.

description:

(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

name: Shifti: Fix Sleep Schedule
description:
Fix your sleep schedule, 15 minutes at a time.

Shifti helps you move your bedtime and wake-up time earlier step by step, without trying to force a huge sleep change in one night.

Instead of telling you to wake up hours earlier tomorrow, Shifti shifts your schedule gradually with small 15-minute steps. Each step gives you a clear bedtime target and wake-up target, so you know exactly what to do tonight and tomorrow morning.

• Create a personalized sleep schedule

Wake tasks help make your alarm harder to ignore. You can choose a simple hold task, solve quick math challenges, or scan a saved barcode away from your bed to confirm you are awake.

Shifti also includes loud alarm protection, wake confirmation, snooze, reboot rescheduling, and progress tracking to help make your wake-up routine more reliable.

Why Shifti is different:

Most alarm clock apps only ring. Shifti helps you plan your sleep schedule before the alarm rings. It combines a gradual sleep schedule plan, bedtime reminders, wake tasks, and progress tracking so you can build consistency step by step.

Use Shifti to:

• Fix your sleep schedule gradually
• Stop waking up late
• Build a better morning routine
• Shift your bedtime earlier
• Wake up with a smarter alarm
• Reduce missed mornings
• Stay consistent after setbacks

Shifti is not a medical app and does not diagnose, treat, or cure sleep disorders. It is designed to support better sleep habits, bedtime routines, and wake-up consistency.

Start small. Wake better. Fix your sleep schedule 15 minutes at a time.

With Timeshifter, you will receive highly personalized advice based on your sleep pattern, chronotype, work schedule, and personal preferences.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science
// Optimizes your sleep, alertness, and performance

Using Timeshifter is as simple as taking small actions at specific times.

NO EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED

Timeshifter is a highly empowering experience, and it requires no special equipment. Just a sleep mask and your favorite dark sunglasses.

name: Timezone Converter World Clock
description:
Timezone converts a moment between places, keeps a world clock of the cities
you care about, and finds the hours when everybody is awake at once. It works
with no connection at all.

WHAT MOST TIME ZONE APPS GET WRONG

A time zone is not a city, and an offset is not a time zone. A zone is a rule:
a history of offsets and the dates they changed. Almost every converter here
ignores that, looks up two offsets, subtracts them and adds the difference to
the time you typed. That is wrong three ways:

• It uses TODAY'S offsets for a date in July. London is UTC+0 now and UTC+1
then.

• It uses one country's changeover dates for another. America moves its clocks
three weeks before Europe does, so for three weeks every March New York is
four hours behind London, not five.

• It cannot represent the answer at all when the local time it was handed does
not exist, or exists twice.

Here, converting is reading one point on the timeline in another set of rules.
There is no arithmetic to get wrong.

THE TWO MORNINGS A YEAR

On the morning the clocks go forward, an hour of local time does not happen.
There is no 2:30am in New York on 8 March. On the night they go back, an hour
happens twice: 1:30am in London on 25 October is two different moments, sixty
minutes apart.

Almost every app handles this silently — it shows 3:30 when you typed 2:30, or
picks one of the two 1:30s and never mentions the other. This one says so, in a
sentence, and lets you take the second.

It also knows Britain loses a different hour from America: the clocks go
forward at 1am there, so 2:30 is an ordinary time in London that morning and a
missing one in New York.

WHEN CAN WE ALL TALK

Pick two to five places and say what hours each of them works — nine to five,
eight to four, or ten at night to six in the morning. The app shows every
stretch of the day that is inside everybody's window.

It handles the day boundary, because it never works in local dates: Tokyo's
Monday morning really is Los Angeles's Sunday afternoon. And when there is NO
overlap — the honest answer for the Pacific against the American west coast on
office hours — it says so in words, rather than showing an empty strip you will
assume failed to load.

Places forty-five minutes off the hour work properly: India, Nepal, the Chatham
Islands and Eucla are real, and a three-quarter-usable hour is shown as one.

THE CLOCKS

Every city you add, ticking: the local time, whether it is yesterday, today or
tomorrow there, and how far ahead or behind you it is. Every row recomputes
itself every second, so land somewhere and the whole list re-reads itself
against your new zone.

SEARCHING

Type a city, not an abbreviation. Accents do not matter: sao paulo finds São
Paulo and zurich finds Zürich. Abbreviations are never an input, because they
cannot mean one zone — CST is three zones and IST is two — though the app will
show you one beside a place you chose.

The whole IANA database is in the app: every zone, every historical offset.
Nothing is fetched.

ALSO

• 12-hour or 24-hour, or follow the phone
• Compare against the phone's zone, or pin one while you are away
• Light and dark, and Material You if you want it
• Save a copy of your list to a file — this is how you move to a new phone

WHAT IT WILL NOT DO

No location, ever. Detecting which zone you are standing in is the flagship
feature of the paid rivals here and it is refused: the phone already knows its
own zone for free, and every other place on your list is one you typed.

No account, no sync, no server, and no notifications — nothing here will ever
interrupt you. Uninstalling deletes your list, and Save a copy is how you move
it.

Three permissions, all of them for the ads that keep it free.

name: nomatch: nomad community
description:
nomatch helps you meet other van life travelers, RVers and digital nomads near you, right now. Open the map, see who is parked nearby, and make travel friends on the road.

Everyone on nomatch already lives the van life. No explaining. No "wait, you live in a van?" The membership is the filter.

— Who it is for —

Full-time van life travelers, RVers and skoolie dwellers. Camper van owners and car campers. Digital nomads working from the road. Solo travelers who want company without swiping.

— How it works —

Open the map and see nomads nearby. Tap "down for" to say what you are up for today: coffee, a hike, camping, cowork, dog walk, drinks, camper van help, or just parking nearby. Browse profiles, express interest, and when it is mutual you exchange contact details.

No swiping. No algorithm deciding who you see. The community is small by design.

— Making travel friends, not dating —

nomatch is built for friendship first. Dating is opt-in and off by default, so you can look for someone to hike or go camping with without being read as looking for a date. Choose which one you want and see people who want the same.

— When van life gets lonely —

The first months on the road are the loneliest, and the travel friends you make you might not see again for a year. That is the problem nomatch exists to solve. Open the map in a new town and there are already people nearby who understand the life.

— Traveling solo, and safety —

Every member is photo verified before they appear on the map, with a real selfie and real vehicle photos checked against their profile. Your position is shown as an approximate area rather than an exact point, and distances are rounded. Contact details are shared only when interest is mutual, and there is no in-app chat, so nobody can message you uninvited. Solo travelers, including solo female travelers, can see who is genuinely nearby and genuinely who they say they are.

— What makes it different —

• Live map of van life travelers and nomads nearby, not profiles from 500 miles away
• Activity tags, so you match on what you want to do today
• Photo and vehicle verification for every member
• Mutual interest before any contact details are exchanged
• Travel friends first, dating opt-in
• Built for the van life and anyone who does not stay in one place

— nomatch+ —

The core experience is free. nomatch+ adds:

• See everyone who is interested in you (free members see one at a time)
• More "down for" tags
• Priority placement on the map
• Advanced filters
• Nearby nomad alerts when van life travelers, campers and RV travelers appear near you

Whether you are parked at a campsite, mid camping trip, or pulling into a new town, your travel friends are already here.

Find your van life friends on the road.

name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker for people who want to remember what they did and when. Log every watering, build a care history for each plant, and let Ploi learn your routine instead of following a generic schedule.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can tell you exactly how often to water your plants: it depends on light, humidity, pot size and season. So Ploi learns instead of guessing. Log a watering, and Ploi picks up your real rhythm and moves the next reminder to match. The more you log, the better the reminders fit.

Your plants on the home screen

Add the Ploi widget to your home screen in one of three sizes and see what needs care without opening the app. It shows what is overdue and what is due today, the weather where your plants live, and a count of the plants that are already happy. Tap a plant and it opens. Under Settings you choose what the widget shows and write your own message for the days when everything is done.

A journal for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline, and you can scroll back through it any time. Weeks later you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went without water, or the day a new leaf appeared. It is a care log and a plant diary in one.

Growth photos over time

Add a photo to any log entry and watch your plant's story come together. A fiddle leaf fig, a monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily all look different six months on, and Ploi keeps every photo so you can see the change for yourself.

Care guides by species

Ploi includes care guides for individual plant species, covering watering, light, soil and humidity. Look up what your plant needs instead of relying on a generic houseplant article.

Plant identification

Not sure what you have? Take a photo and Ploi identifies the species, then starts a care log for it. Most people start with identification — but what Ploi is really for is everything you record afterwards.

Wishlist and rooms

Keep a wishlist of plants you want, and group the ones you own by room or windowsill, so you can water everything in one trip around the house.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? How has it changed? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Subscribe for unlimited plants and advanced care features.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: GardenIt - AI Garden Planner
description:
GardenIt is an AI garden planner that helps you grow veggies from seed with tomato tips, watering reminders, and an easy garden tracker — from the first sowing date through harvest.

If you have ever bought seedlings in the wrong month, overplanted a balcony, or forgotten to water until leaves wilt, this app is for you. GardenIt matches vegetables, herbs, and flowers to your climate, sunlight, and space, then builds a care schedule you can actually follow. Plan a square-foot vegetable garden, track tomatoes and other crops, and get reminders so nothing dries out or goes unharvested.

WHY AN AI GARDEN PLANNER

Most gardening apps hand you a plant encyclopedia and leave you to guess. GardenIt is built around the bed you actually have. You lay out veggies on a square-foot grid, see which neighbors help or compete, and get a watering list tied to that layout. The assistant answers questions about this garden — pests, soil, what to plant now — not a generic blog post.

GROW VEGGIES FROM SEED

Starting from seed is where first-year gardens stall. GardenIt shows sowing months for your climate, plus spacing, sun, soil, and harvest windows, so you know when to start tomatoes, peppers, lettuce, beans, cucumbers, and other vegetables. Use the garden tracker to log planted dates, notes, photos, harvests, and what did not survive.

TOMATO TIPS FOR YOUR CLIMATE

Tomatoes are the crop people want most — and the one that fails without a plan. GardenIt gives tomato tips in context: companions on the grid, watering, feeding, pruning, and harvest windows. Ask the AI assistant about blossom drop, yellow leaves, when to sow, or how much sun a pot needs, and get advice for your climate and sunlight.

REMINDERS YOU WILL ACTUALLY USE

A garden tracker only works if it nudges you on the right day. Watering, fertilizing, sowing, pruning, and harvest reminders sit on a Today list and a garden calendar. Skip watering when rain is coming. A home widget shows unfinished garden tasks at a glance, so you do not open the app only after plants wilt. Set a reminder time that matches how you garden — a few minutes on a balcony or a longer weekend on an allotment.

KEY FEATURES

√ AI garden planner — ask about this garden, pests, and what to plant now
√ Grow veggies from seed — sowing months, spacing, sun, and soil for your climate
√ Tomato tips — companions, feeding, and harvest windows for tomatoes and other vegetables
√ Easy garden tracker — journal notes, photos, harvests, and care history per plant
√ Watering reminders — a care schedule for watering, feeding, sowing, pruning, and harvest
√ Square-foot bed planner — place companions on a grid and avoid bad neighbors
√ Climate-aware plant picks — suggestions that fit your zone and season
√ Photo plant ID — snap a plant or a problem leaf and get practical care tips
√ Weather-aware watering — skip watering tasks when rain is on the way
√ Plant catalog — vegetables, herbs, flowers, and fruit with companions and spacing
√ Home widget — today’s unfinished garden tasks at a glance

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create a garden and set space, sunlight, soil, and climate (GPS or manual).
2. Choose veggies and other plants, then lay them out on the square-foot grid.
3. GardenIt builds a care schedule and garden tracker from that layout.
4. Follow watering reminders, log notes, and ask the AI garden planner when you are stuck.

PERFECT FOR

- First-year vegetable gardens and seed starting at home
- Tomato growers who want reminders and companion planting
- Balcony, terrace, and container gardeners
- Backyard beds, allotments, and small plots
- Anyone who wants an easy garden tracker and a watering list they will actually use

DOWNLOAD GARDENIT

Plan the bed before you plant. Grow veggies from seed with tomato tips, reminders, and an easy garden tracker — and keep the garden alive through the season with GardenIt, your AI garden planner.

name: Veggie Garden Planner
description:
The Veggie Garden Planner provides you with clearly arranged information that you need to quickly compose your vegetable garden patch.

Before purchase we provide a free download so you can see for yourself what value the app provides.
Choose vegetables that harmonise well together. You will find information regarding good/bad neighbor plants for each vegetable.

For your chosen garden composition you get tabular overviews to quickly determine sowing/harvest times, and which interactions exist between vegetables.

As an bonus feature, you can visually arrange your vegetable patch with our Patch Plan Editor - with vital information regarding planting distance & good/bad neighbors at your fingertips.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.

Our garden planner helps you to quickly and clearly select your desired vegetable and fruit varieties. Improve your harvest by the right plant location, whether sunny location or depleted soil. Then simply plant low-growing plants that will thrive ideally with the sunlight in your garden.

Companion planting:
Pay particular attention to mixed cropping, making sure your planned vegetable varieties get along well with each other in the bed and garden. You will find information on good and bad neighbors for each variety.
Once you have selected your planned vegetables, you can quickly see the interrelationships between the varieties on the neighbor overview. In the clear calendar you can immediately see which vegetables need to be sown when, and from when they can be harvested.

Patch planner:
As a bonus feature, you can use the virtual bed plan to create your patch and freely arrange your desired vegetable varieties. Essential information such as planting distances, location selection, nutrient requirements and good/bad neighbors are displayed directly.

Multiple patchs:
You can also create multiple beds - even for several years. Simply take over the plantings from the previous year and optimize your bed according to your needs.

Own varieties:
If our large selection of vegetables, fruits and herbs is not enough for you, you can also create your own special varieties. For example, take the data of a vegetable and edit it. Take your own photos of your vegetables and customize your varieties.

Pre-plan on the tablet:
Pre-plan your bed on your tablet - save your planning in the cloud - with your smartphone you can wonderfully track or optimize the planning in the garden.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.
