name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about. InvenDo is a home inventory app for your kitchen and the rest of the house: it keeps track of what you have, where it is stored and when it expires, and reminds you in time.

Scan a barcode or type a name, put the item in a storage place (fridge, freezer, pantry, garage, bathroom cabinet), and you always know what is in the house without going to look.

STOP THROWING FOOD AWAY
- Nothing spoils at the back of the fridge again: give an item an expiry date and it is flagged as Expires soon, then Already expired
- A reminder arrives at the time of day you choose, so you use things while they are still good
- Opened a jar or a pack? Mark it opened, and InvenDo sets a Consume by date from the shelf life you enter once, then remembers it for next time

NEVER RUN OUT OF WHAT YOU ALWAYS NEED
- Coffee, diapers, cat food: set a Minimum quantity and InvenDo tells you before the last one is gone
- Everything below its minimum sits on one screen, ready to go onto the shopping list
- Set the minimum for a whole category, not just item by item

BUY ONLY WHAT IS MISSING
- A shopping list built from what your pantry actually lacks, instead of from memory
- Group the list by store, so one trip covers one shop
- Check things off in the aisle, then move what you bought straight into your inventory
- Send the grocery list to whoever is going out, as plain text

ADD THINGS IN SECONDS
- Scan a barcode to add an item, scan again to take one away
- A scanned barcode can fill in the product name and photo for you (available in many countries, not all)
- Start typing and InvenDo suggests things you have had before

FIND ANYTHING WITHOUT SEARCHING THE HOUSE
- Storage places inside storage places: the freezer, then the top drawer
- Categories with colors, and subcategories when you need them
- Photos of your items and your storage places, and an icon for each storage place
- Unit sizes that add up for you: 1 pack = 6 pcs, or 1 pack = 250 g, with the total on hand
- Search your whole home inventory by name or by voice

KEEP THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD IN SYNC
- Invite your partner, children or roommates by email, and everyone sees the same list as it changes
- Keep several lists (home, parents' house, a hobby collection) and choose who sees which
- People you invite get the paid features on your shared list at no extra cost
- Works offline, syncs when you are back online
- Check the shopping list off from an Android home screen widget, or open your inventory in a browser at web.invendo.app
- Export to Excel whenever you like, or import a spreadsheet you already keep

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants a pantry inventory that is actually up to date. Food in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Medicines and their shelf life. Cosmetics. Clothes you forget you own. Tools in the garage. Hobby collections. Wine, spices, camping gear, baby supplies, printer cartridges. It is built for a household rather than a business, and it is simple enough that the rest of the family will actually use it.

NO ADS, AND A GENEROUS FREE VERSION
The inventory, storage places, categories, the shopping list, barcode scanning, expiry and low-quantity reminders, Excel export, sharing the list, the widget and sync across devices are all free, and there are no ads anywhere in the app. Premium adds photos, storage icons, Excel import, deeper subcategories, extra lists, inviting other people, filling the shopping list from low-quantity items in one tap, and the web app. Take it monthly, yearly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase: pay once and use it forever.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@invendo.app, a real person answers, usually within a day.
Guides and answers: https://help.invendo.app
More about InvenDo: https://invendo.app

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: Ownitory - Home Inventory
description:
Ownitory helps you photograph, catalog, and value everything you own — room by room — so you have a complete, insurer-ready record the moment you need it. No account. No cloud. No subscription. Your inventory is a file you own, stored only on your device.

WHY OWNITORY
Most home inventory apps ask you to create an account, store your data on their servers, and pay a monthly fee to keep using features you already paid for. Some have shut down entirely, taking users' inventories with them. Ownitory works differently: everything happens on your phone, nothing is ever uploaded anywhere unless you explicitly choose to share or back it up yourself, and you pay once.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Snap a photo and log an item in seconds
• Organize by room, with running totals for each room, category, and your whole home
• Track brand, model, serial number, purchase price, current value, and condition
• Flag high-value items automatically for insurance riders
• Generate a claim-ready PDF report — grouped by room, with photos, itemized values, and a grand total
• Export everything to CSV for your own spreadsheet or your insurer's system
• Back up your entire inventory to a single file, saved wherever you choose
• Optional PIN or fingerprint lock to keep your inventory private
• Light and dark theme

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Whether you're proactively documenting your home before anything happens, or reconstructing an inventory after a fire, flood, or theft, Ownitory is designed to move at the speed of a stressful moment — fast entry, clear organization, and a report you can hand to an adjuster with confidence.

YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES
- No account or login, ever
- No internet connection required for any core feature
- No data collected, tracked, or transmitted by Ownitory
- One-time purchase unlocks unlimited items and report exports — no subscriptions
- Free to try up to 5 items before unlocking

Ownitory is not affiliated with any insurance company. It's simply the fastest, most private way to document what you own.

name: ToteTracker: Home Inventory
description:
Know where everything is.

ToteTracker keeps a searchable inventory of your whole home — names, categories, values, and locations, all in one place. Catalog a room in minutes, and when you need something later it's a search, not an excavation.

Adding things
• Smart Photo Scan — photograph an item and review what the scan found: name, category, and an estimated value. Confirm it or correct it.
• Smart Multi-Item Scan — one photo of a full shelf, each item cataloged on its own.
• Import Receipt — photograph a paper receipt, or pick a screenshot or PDF of an order confirmation, and each product line becomes a draft you review. Groceries and other consumables are skipped and listed, so you can still include one if you want it.

Finding things again
• Smart Search matches meaning, not exact words. Search "winter gear" and find the jacket and the gloves, even if you never typed those words.
• Search with the camera, too — snap a photo and Smart Search finds the items that look like it.
• Organize items into nested containers (rooms, shelves, totes, boxes) so every item has a place — and mark an item as in use when it leaves its spot.
• Container labels — print QR labels for your containers, or blank labels you claim as you pack, and stick them on. Scanning one with ToteTracker or any camera app opens that box's contents. Labels your boxes already carry can be linked and scanned the same way.
• Duplicate detection checks your inventory daily, flags items that look logged twice, and merges the ones you confirm. Scan a barcode you already logged and ToteTracker offers to open that item instead of adding it again.

Made for Android
• Home-screen widget — scan, search, add, or open a labeled box from your home screen in one tap. Choose which buttons it shows in Settings.
• App lock — switch it on and ToteTracker asks for your fingerprint, face, or screen lock before it opens.
• Push notifications — an alert when you're invited to a shared inventory, when someone joins yours, or when your trial is about to end.

Share with your household
Invite your partner, family, or roommates by email and everyone sees and edits the same inventory. Each member is on their own plan.

On every device, online or off
Your inventory syncs across your devices and stays readable offline, so you can look things up in a basement or a storage unit with no signal. Encrypted in transit and at rest. Row-level security means only you and the people you invite to a shared inventory can read it. Export your data anytime.

Getting started
Start with a 7-day free trial, no credit card required. After the trial, subscribe in the app through Google Play — monthly, 6-month, or annual. Every plan includes up to 2,000 items, 500 containers, and 100 Smart Actions a month, with one-time packs when you need more. A ToteTracker account is required.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: BoardGameGeek
description:
This is the official app for BoardGameGeek, an online resource and community that aims to be the definitive source for board game and card game content. Daily new content, continuously updated by millions of passionate users, makes ‘the Geek’ the largest and most up-to-date place to get gaming information. You can become a registered member of BoardGameGeek (BGG) for free, and we welcome your contributions in the form of ratings, reviews, and thoughts on games!

BGG features reviews, ratings, images, play-aids, translations, and session reports from board game geeks around the world, as well as live discussion forums.

Here you’ll find many types of board games, including thousands you’ve probably never seen in a store. We cover not only board games but also dice games, card games, tile-laying games, and games of dexterity. We have abstracts, economic games, dungeon crawls, city building, diplomacy and negotiation, trading, puzzle games, strategy games, party games, war games, and many more. We run the gamut from the light and whimsical Carcassonne to the serious and heavy empire-building of Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition. Well-known games like Monopoly exist in the database as well, although you’ll find almost all users prefer modern games that exhibit advancements in game play and component quality since Monopoly was first published.

Your monthly or annual AdBlock subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. Cancel anytime in your device’s Account Settings. Score Counter is free to use. Premium is a one-time purchase (a monthly plan is available too) that unlocks everything marked Premium above and removes the ads. Some Premium features can be used for a single game by watching a short ad instead.

Focus on the game, not the math!

name: APA Pool Scorer
description:
You don't have to deal with cumbersome paper scoring anymore! The 9-ball APA Pool Scorer app makes it very easy to keep track of your pocketed balls for practice or tournament play.

The 9-Ball APA Scorer app uses the APA (America Pool Association) scoring system with the Equalizer Handicap® method, where all pocketed balls are one points, with the exception of the 9 ball that values two points. Players win by points, rather than racks won. The number of points needed for a win is determined by the players official APA Skill Level (e.g., a SL5 needs 38 points to win, while a SL6 needs 46 points). Dead balls can be marked as such. The app also supports marking timeouts, defense shots, innings, break-and-runs, and 9-on-the-snap.

name: Trust App: Build Self Trust
description:
Stop chasing motivation. Start building self-trust.

Most habit trackers fail because they demand short-term intensity and painful streaks. When life gets busy, you break the streak, lose momentum, and crash into burnout.

The Trust App changes the game. Built entirely on a Performance Capacity framework, it helps high-achieving professionals, executives, and entrepreneurs build unshakeable self-trust through sustainable daily habits.

By registering habits you intend to practice and logging the ones you complete, the Trust App helps you develop a clearer relationship between intention and follow-through. Over time, this process supports greater consistency, awareness, and confidence in your ability to count on yourself.

Turn your personal growth into a strategic game you actually want to play.

HOW THE BALANCE GAME WORKS

The Trust App moves you away from all-or-nothing tracking and focuses on consistency across your entire life. You track your day by making points-based deposits into an interactive Balance Chart.

* The Balance Chart -- Track actions across 7 foundational life categories. Habits carry point values matching their effort, giving you a real, stress-free picture of your capacity.

* The Trust Journey - Progress through a guided growth framework built around long-term habits. Success is measured across weeks, not single days, to encourage sustainable growth.

* Magical Moments - Log meaningful wins, sudden clarity, and insights to measure internal awareness alongside external metrics. These are the moments that make life sweet, and the Trust App helps you capture them so you never forget.

* Trust Tribe & Teams - Build accountability. Form your inner circle to share perspective, see progress in the Discovery Feed, and grow with peers.

WHY THE METRIC OF SELF-TRUST MATTERS

True productivity isn't about doing everything, it's about keeping the promises you make to yourself. By matching what you intend to do with what you actually finish, the Trust App naturally eliminates the gap between intention and action, helping you scale your professional life without sacrificing your well-being or family.

The Trust App is built on the idea that self-trust develops when actions consistently align with stated intentions. Measurement is used as a tool for awareness and clarity, not comparison or self-criticism. The focus is on building reliability with yourself through small, repeatable actions that add up over time.

This approach emphasizes sustainability and alignment rather than intensity or performance. The goal is not to do everything, but to do what you commit to doing and to understand the impact of those choices.

PERFECT FOR HIGH-ACHIEVERS MANAGING:
* Executive or professional burnout
* Scattered daily routines and inconsistent habits
* The struggle to balance professional output with physical and mental health
* Rebuilding self-confidence and personal reliability

WHAT’S NEW IN THIS BUILD
* Gamified Motivation - Track milestones, unlock badges, and earn Trust Coins.
* Refined Habit Library - Upgraded habit concepts complete with video guides.
* UI Enhancements - Clean, high-contrast updates to the Watch Feed and Balance Chart.
* Community Features - Complete rollout of Trust Tribe and Trust Teams for partner accountability.

---
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
The Trust App includes both free and subscription-based premium features. Subscription options, pricing, and terms are clearly displayed prior to purchase. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled at any time through your App Store account settings.

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler
description:
ScaleChef — Recipe Scaler & Kitchen Converter

Cooking for two when the recipe serves six? Doubling a batch for guests? ScaleChef does the kitchen math for you — and it all works offline, with no account and no ads.

SCALE A RECIPE LIVE
Save a recipe with its ingredient list and original serving count, then just tap the servings up or down. Every quantity rescales instantly, written the way you'd actually measure it — "1 1/2 cups", not "1.4732". No more scribbling on the back of an envelope.

MEASURE BY WEIGHT WHEN IT MATTERS
For baking staples like flour, sugar, and butter, ScaleChef shows a gram estimate next to the cup measurement, so you can switch to a scale for the ingredients where precision counts.

SWITCH BETWEEN US AND METRIC
Flip a whole recipe between US cups/ounces and metric millilitres/grams. ScaleChef picks sensible units for each ingredient automatically instead of leaving you with "0.95 litres".

QUICK CONVERT
Need a one-off answer? Pick a from-unit and a to-unit, type a number, done. Volume and weight, US and metric — plus an optional ingredient-weight estimate.

OVEN & PANS
• Convert oven temperatures between °F and °C, with the matching UK gas mark
• Find a substitute baking pan — ScaleChef ranks your other pans by how closely they match, and tells you how much to scale the recipe to fit

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE

Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

Download Prompted and start today — a private diary with guided prompts for reflection, shadow work and growth.

To live a happy and fulfilling life, it is important for us to have good mental health and a strong sense of self-love.

Here are the tools that you will find in the Gratitude app:

1. 📖 GRATITUDE JOURNAL

A gratitude journal or diary opens up your eyes to reflect on all the little blessings in your life.

In daily life, we can lose sight of what we are fortunate to have and by keeping a journal you can slowly and steadily shift your perspective to focus on what is good in your life.

The Gratitude app will send you reminders with prompts to help you build the habit of journaling.

You can also add photos to your journal entries, build a gratitude journal streak, and access hundreds of journal prompts.

2. 💗POSITIVE AFFIRMATIONS

If you’ve heard about manifestation or the law of attraction, you’ve probably heard about affirmations.

Positive daily affirmations change our self-talk to focus on more loving and kind thoughts towards ourselves.

They give us the motivation we need to keep moving forward and believe in ourselves.

The Gratitude app has hundreds of affirmations that you can listen to or read, as per your need.

You can also write your own affirmations, add music, and record your voice to them.

Positive affirmations are a dearly loved tool and with this affirmations app, it is very easy for you to practice them.

3. 🏞CREATE VISION BOARDS

Another super popular manifestation tool is a vision board, also called dream board. The vision board serves as a collage of your dreams and goals in the form of photos, quotes, and affirmations.

In the Gratitude app, we’ll help you make a great vision board using sections, goal ideas, and create a video of all your goals together with music. You can also make multiple vision boards!

4. 🌈DAILY ZEN

We understand the need for motivation and inspiration as you build a healthy routine with these self-help tools, which is why Daily Zen is an important part of the app.

Here, you will find gratitude quotes, motivation quotes, thought switch ideas, thank you cards, affirmations, blog articles, and real-life stories of people who changed their mindset with gratitude.

One simple switch can begin a massive change in your life. A self-care tool like Gratitude will help you build a healthy routine to take care of your mental health, achieve your goals, and live a beautiful life.

name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily gratitude diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

A JOURNAL APP THAT ASKS FOR LESS

Most journal apps hand you a blank page and a cursor. This one asks the same question every evening, so a diary entry is finished in the time it takes to make tea. If you have looked for a free journal app, a gratitude diary or a daily writing habit and bounced off the effort, that is the gap this gratitude app is built for.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this one only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology as a gratitude exercise, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening, in the ordinary mood you happen to be in.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily gratitude diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: Menu cost calculator
description:
This calculator is developed for for financially literate people who verify receipts and invoices issued by restaurants.

It's no secret that you can get cheated in a restaurant and pay a little more than you need to. To prevent this, this calculator has been created.

Suitable for a large company and banquets, when you need to quickly calculate the cost of all dishes.

The menu calculator will allow you to quickly check the restaurant bill against a pre-entered list of dishes(food)

Imagine a situation, you go to the same place for lunch every day and order about the same meals.

Your restaurant has a permanent list of business lunch menus.
After lunch you pay at the restaurant.

To check the cost of your lunch, simply add all the restaurant's dishes to our app.

This can be done on the 👉Food tab via the menu.

When visiting a restaurant, add the dishes you ordered to the calculator from the 👉Food screen. You can do this by clicking the add button near the name.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and select them using the checkbox to the right of each dish or by pressing.

The app will calculate the total cost of your lunch.

Before going to the restaurant

You should start working with the application from the restaurants tab.
Add all the places where you go to eat on this tab.

Next, go to the 👉 Food tab and select add from the menu.

Add all the dishes you would normally order for each of your restaurants. Specify the price of each dish and select a restaurant when adding.

It is better to take a picture of the restaurant menu before going to it and add the main dishes that you plan or already order often.


How to use app in a restaurant?
After lunch, add all the dishes you ordered through the 👉 Food tab. Click add next to each dish.

You can change a restaurant in the drop-down list of dishes at the top of the list of dishes. All dishes of the selected restaurant will be shown.

Another alternative option for filling out the list for calculating the cost is to go to the Restaurants tab and by long-clicking on the selected restaurant select 👉Load menu.

Finally, delete the dish through the menu by long pressing on the dish on the 👉Food tab.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Identify potential drug interactions and uncover risks beyond the surface.

Set up automated reminders to maintain consistency and prevent missed doses.

Understand the ingredients in your medications and manage those that may pose health risks.
4. Medicine Scanner

5. Customised Profiles
Create personalised medication profiles for each family member to simplify the management of complex regimens.

Plan and monitor medication history and upcoming prescriptions for proactive management.
7. Connect with Professionals

8. Data Security

Why Choose MyRxProfile?

By centralizing medication information, analyzing drug interactions, and empowering users to take an active role in their health, MyRxProfile simplifies medication management. The app supports informed decision-making and helps improve overall health management.

Want to go for a nice walk every day? Or maybe give 3 hugs every Saturday and Sunday? Join us on this journey!

Whether you want to read some more, stop smoking, start working out or even just track how many hours you wasted on Facebook, this app lets you do it!

•  Track multiple habits, repeated to do's or goals, each in its own calendar

•  Export to CSV
•  Dark theme
•  Google Fit integration

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

name: Product Management - CraftUp
description:
CraftUp is the product management learning app for product managers, aspiring PMs, founders, designers and developers who want to build better products. It helps you learn product management step by step with short, focused daily lessons you can actually apply in your work and side projects.

If you want to start a product management career, move from junior to mid or senior product manager, or simply make smarter product decisions as a founder, CraftUp gives you a clear, structured path. You learn modern product management, not random tips or outdated theory.

CraftUp is built around real product work. Each lesson focuses on one concrete product management decision: understanding a user problem, validating an idea, designing an MVP, planning a simple experiment, running user interviews, defining product metrics, or deciding what to ship next. You do not just read about product management, you practice product thinking every day.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

With CraftUp you will learn core product management skills, including:

How to find real problems worth solving using user research

How to validate ideas with interviews, surveys and simple experiments

How to design and build MVPs that test the right product assumptions

How to get your first users and grow from zero with limited time and budget

How to use feedback, data and metrics to improve your product

How to understand product market fit and avoid false signals

How to prioritize a roadmap when everything feels important

How to make better product decisions with scarce resources

How to think and communicate like a product manager or founder

This is practical product management training you can use if you are preparing for a PM role, already working as a product manager, or building your own startup.

WHO CRAFTUP IS FOR

CraftUp is designed for:

People starting from zero who want a clear way to learn product management

Aspiring product managers preparing for their first PM job or interview

Junior product managers who want to grow faster and build confidence

Founders and indie hackers who need product management skills to ship smarter

Designers and developers who want to understand product decisions, not just tickets

Professionals in other fields who want to learn product thinking and turn ideas into products

HOW IT WORKS

CraftUp breaks product management into small, guided steps. Lessons are short, structured and focused on one topic at a time. You can complete a lesson in a few minutes, but over time you build deep understanding of how real product management works.

You learn how to frame user problems, write simple hypotheses, design experiments, pick metrics that matter, and make tradeoffs. Many lessons use examples from real products and real product managers so you see how product thinking works in practice, not in theory.

WHY CRAFTUP IS DIFFERENT

CraftUp is not another generic business course or a playlist of long video lectures. It is a dedicated product management learning environment. The content is focused only on product management and product thinking. No fluff, no motivational noise, just clear explanations and concrete actions.

The experience is calm and intentional. You will not find growth hacking tricks or pressure to hustle more. Instead, CraftUp helps you build a consistent learning habit so you actually stick with product management over weeks and months. You get just enough structure to keep moving forward without feeling overwhelmed.

CraftUp is your companion in the messy but rewarding process of learning product management and turning ideas into real products. Whether you want to become a product manager, level up in your current role, or build your own product as a founder, CraftUp gives you the product management skills, mindset and practice you need.

Learn product management. Build better products.

name: Missed Notifications Reminder
description:
Unfortunately Android doesn't have default integrated functionality to notify user periodically about missing calls/messages/other notifications via sound (only LED is blinking). This opensource tool allows to monitor notifications from any applications which are important for You (including missed calls, messengers, SMS, e-mails, etc) and perform sound reminder periodically

Just launch app, allow it to receive notification events, select reminder interval and important applications. That's it. If there are any unhandled notifications from thet selected apps in the statusbar, app will notify You periodically with the notification sound you choose.

IMPORTANT: if app doesn't work please try to find solution for your phone here https://dontkillmyapp.com

The battery is used only if there are missed notifications which requires periodical reminder. App wakes phone to perform sound notification and then sleep again.

The app uses minimum set of required permissions.

Android 4.0-4.2 support is experimental such as these OS versions doesn't have a 100% working method to monitor notification removal.

XIAOMI users should enable application autostart explicitly in the security settings
Huawei users should disable battery automanagement for the Missed Notifications Reminder app: in the Battery > App Launch -> Manage All Automatically - - > uncheck MNR app

Source code is available at github: https://github.com/httpdispatch/MissedNotificationsReminder

Big thanks to all contributors:
Sergiy Belozorov (https://github.com/rryk) for limit reminder repeats and dismiss notification features
naofum (https://github.com/naofum) for Japanese translation
Gerasim Panteleev for bulgarian translation
Heimen Stoffels (https://github.com/Vistaus) for Dutch translation
Olaf Kuba for design updates

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

name: Soothfy: ADHD Planner, Anxiety
description:
Soothfy is an ADHD planner and mental health app built for people whose brains work differently. If anxiety, OCD, PTSD, or panic attacks make daily life harder than it needs to be, you are in the right place.

Most mental health apps were not built for how ADHD and anxious brains actually work. They give you a generic meditation when you are mid panic attack, or a to-do list when executive function has completely shut down. Soothfy was built around the reality of living with these conditions, not the ideal version of it.

The feature our users come back to every day is Instant Relief. When anxiety spikes, when ADHD makes focusing impossible, or when a panic attack starts, you open Soothfy and work through four steps. Pick your condition, choose the exact symptom from thirty five options, describe what is happening right now, and get 
three CBT activities built for that exact situation with a two minute timer. Not something generic. Something designed for the moment you are in. You track whether it worked, so over time Soothfy learns what actually helps you and what to skip.

Your daily ADHD planner rebuilds every cycle. The AI takes your condition, mood, energy level, and time of day into account before generating a fresh twenty day plan. Every plan includes CBT exercises, focus timers, executive function tasks, habit stacking, behavioral activation, and journaling sessions. Nothing repeats, 
and because the planner understands that ADHD brains do not perform consistently, it adjusts rather than punishing you for the hard days.

The CBT education library walks you through the ABC model, assertiveness training, behavioral activation, and behavior tracking in a way that is practical and specific to your condition. The same tools therapists spend sessions teaching, built into your daily routine so you are applying them in real life, not just reading about them.

The mood tracker and anxiety tracker turn daily check-ins into something genuinely useful. Log your emotions, anxiety levels, and sleep quality every day and Soothfy builds weekly and monthly trend charts that show your actual patterns, your triggers, and how sleep connects to focus, anxiety, and everything else. You can download your mood and anxiety reports and bring them to a therapist or doctor who can actually use that data to help you.

The anxiety journal lets you write, record voice notes, and attach therapeutic sounds directly to entries. The sleep tracker shows how rest affects your ADHD focus and anxiety over time. For neurodivergent users and anyone managing insomnia, stress, or emotional dysregulation, having somewhere to put the weight of the day before sleep is not a small thing. The sound therapy library gives you curated audio designed for ADHD and anxiety, not generic noise. The ADHD timer keeps you on task when executive function is struggling.

Anchor Habits connect your mental health activities to routines you already have. Instead of building new habits from nothing, Soothfy helps you stack CBT exercises onto things you already do every day. That is why the habits built inside this app actually last.

The community brings together people managing ADHD, anxiety, OCD, PTSD, depression, and emotional dysregulation. Real people sharing what is working, what is not, and what living with these conditions honestly looks like day to day. It is moderated, it is honest, and it is the kind of support that reminds you that you are not dealing with this alone.

Soothfy covers nine conditions in one app. ADHD, anxiety, depression, OCD, PTSD, stress, insomnia, anger, and emotional dysregulation. One subscription covers everything. You do not need a different app for each condition you are managing.
The app is free to download. Your first relief session takes under two minutes.

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.


Daily goal setting, minimalistic design beautiful color themes, notifications and more.

name: Google Fit: Activity Tracking
description:
Get to a healthier and more active life with the new Google Fit!

It's hard to know how much or what kind of activity you need to stay healthy. That's why Google Fit collaborated with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Heart Association (AHA) to bring you Heart Points, an activity goal that can help improve your health.

Activities that get your heart pumping harder have tremendous health benefits for your heart and mind. You'll earn one Heart Point for each minute of moderate activity like picking up the pace when walking your dog, and double points for more intense activities like running. It takes just 30-minutes of brisk walking five days a week to reach the AHA and WHO's recommended amount of physical activity shown to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve sleep, and increase overall mental wellbeing.

Google Fit will also help you:

TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS FROM YOUR PHONE OR WATCH
Get instant insights when you exercise and see real-time stats for your runs, walks, and bike rides. Fit will use your Android phone's sensors or Wear OS by Google smartwatch's heart rate sensors to record your speed, pace, route, and more.

MONITOR YOUR GOALS
See your daily progress on your Heart Points and Steps goal. Meeting your goals all the time? Easily adjust your goals to keep challenging yourself to achieve a healthy heart and mind.

MAKE ALL YOUR MOVEMENT COUNT
If you walk, run, or bike throughout the day, your Android phone or Wear OS by Google smartwatch will automatically detect and add your activities to your Google Fit journal to ensure you get credit for every move. Want extra credit? Turn up the tempo on your walks by starting a paced walking workout and stepping to the beat. Enjoy a different type of workout? Select it from a list of activities like pilates, rowing, or spinning, and Google Fit will track all the Heart Points you earn.

CONNECT WITH YOUR FAVORITE APPS AND DEVICES
Fit can show you info from many of your favorite apps and devices to give you a holistic view of your health, so you'll never lose track of your progress. These include Lifesum, Wear OS by Google, Nike+, Runkeeper, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Basis, Sleep as Android, Withings, Xiaomi Mi bands, and more.

CHECK IN AT ANYTIME, FROM ANYWHERE
See a snapshot of your activity history across Fit and your integrated apps in the redesigned journal. Or, get the full picture in browse, where you can find all of your health and wellness data.

KEEP A FINGER ON THE PULSE OF YOUR HEALTH
Breathing is one of the simplest ways to reduce tension and relieve stress. With Fit, checking in with your breath is easy—all you need is your phone camera. As well as your respiratory rate, you can measure your heart rate to get a better understanding of your body’s wellbeing.

VIEW YOUR DAY'S STATS AT A GLANCE
Add a widget to the home screen of your Android phone or set up a tile and complication on your Wear OS by Google smartwatch.

Learn more about Google Fit and see a list of supported apps at: www.google.com/fit

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

Automation

Home screen widgets

Full history

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

1. Open the app and set the allergens you want to detect — including wheat, gluten, milk, nuts, and more
2. Scan a food barcode, or keep scanning in bulk without interruption
3. Get immediate results showing whether matching allergens are found in database data

Useful features:
• Fast detection of common allergens, including wheat
• Bulk scan to review many products in a row without interruption
• Multiple profiles, each with their own allergens, history, and favorites
• Clear, color-coded alerts
• Personalized results based on the active profile's selected allergens
• A growing list of products with no matching allergen found in database data
• Easy sharing with family members

Premium gives you:
• Unlimited product scanning
• Bulk scan mode
• Multiple user profiles
• Full scan history
• Detailed additive information
• Unlimited favorites
• More comprehensive product analysis

Bokha connects to Open Food Facts, a collaborative database with thousands of products worldwide.

Bokha is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
Always verify packaging and ingredient labels before consumption, and consult a qualified healthcare professional for allergy-related decisions.

name: Allervibe: Food Allergy Scan
description:
Scan the barcode. Or photograph the label. Know in about a second whether a food product contains your allergens.

Allervibe is a food allergy scanner, food label scanner and ingredient checker for anyone who reads labels. Point the barcode scanner at any packaged product and Allervibe checks the ingredient list, the allergen declaration and the "may contain" trace warnings against a profile you set up once. You get a clear green, yellow or red verdict, the full ingredient breakdown, and every food additive listed with its E number.

An allergen scanner, a food scanner, a label scanner and an ingredient checker in one app. No account. No sign-in. No waiting.

NEW: SCAN THE LABEL ITSELF, IN ANY LANGUAGE

Not every product is in a database. Photograph the ingredient list and Allervibe reads the label on your device, then checks it against your profile — no barcode needed. Foreign label? Translate it right on your phone: one download per language, offline after that. Gluten free in Italy, dairy free in Spain, celiac anywhere.

WHO IT IS FOR

Shopping gluten free with celiac disease. Managing lactose intolerance or a dairy free diet. Checking for a peanut or tree nut allergy before it goes in the cart. Living with a food intolerance and tired of squinting at 6-point type in the middle of an aisle. Vegans and vegetarians spotting hidden animal ingredients. Travelling, and unable to read the packaging at all.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set your allergen profile once, and choose how strict you want to be about each allergen.
2. Scan the barcode, or photograph the ingredient label.
3. Allervibe matches the product data against your profile.
4. Read the verdict, the full ingredient list and the additives breakdown.

WHAT IT CHECKS FOR

Allervibe covers the 13 most common food allergens: peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, gluten, sesame, shellfish, fish, sulphites, mustard and celery. Product data comes from Open Food Facts, the world's largest open food database, with millions of products from more than 100 countries.

FREE FEATURES

• Daily barcode scans and label photo scans
• Your personal allergen profile, with per-allergen strictness
• Detection across all 13 allergens, including trace and "may contain" warnings
• The full ingredient list for every product you scan
• Allergen and additive guides in the Learn tab
• No ads

ALLERVIBE PRO

• Unlimited scanning
• Your complete scan history, searchable
• Favorites for products you have already checked
• Family profiles — a separate allergen list per person, switched with a tap
• A detailed food additives breakdown with E numbers and common names
• A home screen widget that opens the scanner in one tap

YOUR ALLERGY CARD

A wallet-sized card with your name and allergens, ready to hand to a waiter. Show it in any of 9 languages, or save it to your photos and print it.

FAMILY PROFILES

One person is celiac and shopping gluten free. Another is lactose intolerant. A third reacts to nuts. Switch profiles before you scan; each person gets the answer that applies to them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Allervibe runs on your device. Your profiles, scan history and favorites stay there, and label reading and translation happen on the phone, not on a server. No account required, no data sold, nothing shared about what you scan.

A NOTE ON SAFETY

Allervibe is an informational tool, not a medical device. It reports what the available product data says, and cannot tell you that a product is safe for you. Always read the packaging before you eat. If you have a severe or life-threatening food allergy, do not rely on this app alone — read the label, follow your doctor's guidance, and carry your prescribed medication. Data comes from Open Food Facts, which is community-edited and may be incomplete or out of date. Label photo scanning can misread small print.

The Gold Standard FODMAP Diet Plan

Based on 15+ years of scientific research, studies show the low FODMAP diet is effective at reducing IBS symptoms in up to 75% of people.

People typically feel relief within 10-14 days of starting a low FODMAP plan. IBS Coach is the complete FODMAP diet app for beginners - guiding you through a step-by-step plan, without the stress of figuring it out on your own.

Low FODMAP isn't a forever diet. It's a temporary, structured plan to calm your digestion, identify your unique triggers, and get back to normal living.

Have you been told to try a low FODMAP diet?

You might have been given a FODMAP food list and left to get on with it. Attempting the FODMAP diet with a simple food list when you need a guided plan is the reason people fail the elimination phase or get stuck eating low FODMAP forever.

The Plan in Three Steps

1. Calm your gut: Get your digestion under control with our guided low FODMAP elimination phase.
2. Test your triggers: Safely test your tolerance to specific foods to identify your trigger ingredients. Everyone is different. Don't skip this step.
3. Get back to normal living: Knowing your triggers means you're in control and can enjoy meals again.

What's Included: Your Complete FODMAP Plan

Built with dietitians and doctors, your gold standard FODMAP plan includes:

- Meal Planner & Automated Shopping Lists: Personalised weekly plans with shopping lists built for you.

- Comprehensive Symptom Tracker: Log symptoms, add your own notes, and spot the patterns behind your triggers.
- Progress Reports: Track and monitor your improvement over time.
- Knowledge Bank: Bite-sized education to understand your gut and stay in control.

Daily Science-Backed Education & Practical Tips

As well as the complete FODMAP plan, IBS Coach helps you understand and improve your digestion:

- Diet education: learn about FODMAPs and how ingredients trigger symptoms
- Stress management: science-backed techniques to calm non-dietary triggers

Everyone is different, and your personalised plan helps you take control of your IBS. Join over 100,000 people discovering meals that work for their gut. Get back to living your life again.

name: GastroLog: FODMAP & IBS Diary
description:
GastroLog is a food and symptom diary for people whose gut decides how the day goes. Log what you ate and how you felt, watch which foods keep turning up before a bad day, and bring a clear PDF report to your GI appointments.

The diary itself is free, and it is the whole app. Meals, symptoms, weight, sleep, energy, fluids, medications, your own safe-foods list, the per-food history counts, flare mode and reminders cost nothing, with no trial period and no cap on how much you log. One optional purchase, GastroLog Plus, adds the shareable PDF report and trend charts longer than a fortnight. It is a one-off, not a subscription, and you never need it to keep using the diary.

If you are working through a low FODMAP diet, GastroLog is where you write down what happened. You decide what is in and what is out; the app records how each meal went, so elimination and reintroduction rest on evidence rather than memory. The same applies to IBS, gastroparesis, reflux, chronic nausea and the months after gut surgery.

A food diary that takes two taps

- Repeat a meal in two taps. You eat the same safe things, and the app respects that.
- Six usual meals stay pinned, so the food you eat most is always one tap away.
- Say how much you actually managed, not just what was on the plate.
- Missed a week? Nothing nags. Your diary simply continues.

A symptom tracker with no typing

- Nausea, vomiting, bloating, fullness and reflux, logged with big chips and a five-point severity scale.
- One tap marks a rough patch, and the app quiets down until it passes. It asks for liquids, fluids and symptoms, and nothing else.

Low FODMAP and IBS tracking

- GastroLog does not hand you a FODMAP list. It records the one you are already working from, meal by meal, so a reintroduction that goes badly is written down while it is fresh.
- Mark each food safe, trial or trigger as you learn it. That is your own low FODMAP result, worked out from your meals.
- An IBS tracker that keeps bloating, fullness, reflux and the meals that came before them on one timeline.

Your trigger food list, your call

- Safe, trial and trigger lists that belong to you.
- Once a food has some history, GastroLog shows the plain count — "symptoms followed on 4 of 6 occasions" — and you decide what moves where.
- The app never labels a food for you and never hands you a diet plan. It counts what you logged.

See the shape of your weeks

- The fortnight dashboard lines up symptoms, meals, weight, sleep, energy, fluids and medications on one screen.
- Weight and symptom trends with the rough patches marked.
- The fortnight view is free. A month, three months and the whole record come with Plus.

The report for your GI appointment (Plus)

- A clear PDF: symptom summary, weight trend, meal patterns, your food observations, medications, and the questions you want to ask.
- Built from your diary in seconds and shared straight from your phone.
- Walk in with your story already on paper, instead of trying to remember six weeks of meals in a ten-minute slot.
- Page one is free to preview before you decide whether the report is worth buying.

Who uses a food symptom diary

People managing IBS, the low FODMAP elimination and reintroduction phases, gastroparesis, diabetic gastroparesis, functional dyspepsia, reflux, chronic nausea, cyclic vomiting and post-surgical slow emptying. Anyone told to "keep a food diary and see what sets it off" and handed no tool to do it with. If you are tracking meals against symptoms over months rather than counting calories for a week, this is built for you.

Private by design

- Everything you log stays on your phone. There is no account and there are no ads.
- Anonymous usage counts show us which features get used, never what you logged or who you are.
- Export or delete all of your data whenever you want.

GastroLog is a diary, not a medical device. It counts and shows what you logged. You and your care team decide what it means.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

Then the work begins.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Maybe you feel better.

Maybe you don't.

Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.

That's the part I wanted to fix.

EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.
